jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

We are seeking a Tenant Improvement Project Coordinator to join our Commercial Property Management team in Los Angeles, CA.

You'll help oversee project schedules, bid packages, change orders, and budgets while identifying value engineering opportunities to keep projects on time and on spec. The ideal candidate brings 2–3 years of project experience, knowledge of construction and building codes, and strong communication and leadership skills.

The Project Coordinator works in a team environment with Leasing, Design, and Project Managers. The primary responsibilities of this role are to estimate and manage tenant or capital improvement projects from the earliest conceptual phase up to and through final completion and closeout. This may include running multiple projects simultaneously, performing responsibilities such as planning, schedules, executing contracts, acquiring resources, and third-party contractors or consultants to deliver projects according to schedule. This position provides the planning, organization, direction, coordination, and control to successfully deliver on projects assigned.

**Perks & Benefits:**

When you feel good, you do good. At Onni we put your health at the forefront and give you the choice to select a benefits package that best represents you. From no cost to $19, $45, or $118 per pay our PPO, HSA, and HMO have you covered. In addition, we offer:

* 3 weeks of PTO
* Referral program
* Employee Discount Program
* 401(k) Employee Match
* Up to 50% Employee discount on our Hotel properties
* Up to 30% Friends & family discount on our Hotel Properties
* Residential housing discount after 1 year of continuous employment
* Annual education allowance of up to $1,000 after 1 year of continuous employment

**What You Will Do:**
---------------------

* Responsible for the successful initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, control, and overall closure of assigned tenant improvement projects as well as assist with other projects
* Reviews critical path items, manages changes in project scope, identifies potential issues, and devises contingency plans, and quickly adapts or accelerates projects to meet deadlines
* Coordinates tenant improvement construction projects, and in collaboration with site staff, subcontractors, architects, and engineers
* Collaborates in a team environment with Leasing, Design and Project Managers
* Drafts and coordinates detailed scopes of work for bid packages and contract awards including subcontracts
* Plans and schedules project timelines and milestones using appropriate tools and ensure projects are built in accordance with the schedule. budget, plans, and specs approved by the ownership and the architect/engineers/managers
* Designs reviews for efficiencies and schedule improvements
* Develops, tracks, and maintains project schedules
* Identifies value engineering opportunities to lower the project budget
* Manages change orders and invoicing and prequalifies vendors and subcontractors
* Develops and complete punch lists upon project completion
* Closes out project cleanly and completely within 30 days of project completion
* Participate in post-project review with key project personnel
* Performs other duties as assigned

**What You Bring:**
-------------------

* Demonstrated knowledge of construction and building codes
* Proficiency in MS Outlook, MS Word, MS Excel, and MS Windows
* Ability to read, analyze, and interpret prints, architectural drawings, financial and job cost reports
* Ability to respond to common inquiries or clarifications from tenants, architects, engineers, and property managers
* Ability to multitask in an efficient manner
* Excellent knowledge of the industry and trends impacting the business
* Excellent customer service orientation and excellent interpersonal skills
* Excellent oral and written communication skills
* Strong negotiation and leadership skills
* Good accounting, financial statements, job cost, and cash flow
* Minimum 2-3 years project management experience preferred

**Onni Properties, LLC (“Onni”) will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records for employment in accordance with the California Fair Chance Act, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the City of Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, and other local ordinance, as applicable. You do need to disclose your criminal history or participate in a background check until a conditional job offer is made to you. After making a conditional offer and running a background check, if Onni is concerned about a conviction or convictions that is/are directly related to the job, you will be given the chance to explain the circumstances surrounding the conviction(s), provide mitigating evidence, or challenge the accuracy of the background report. A criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship upon certain job duties of this employment position, and such criminal history may result in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment.**

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
At Nuwave, we are committed to delivering cutting-edge solutions in the wireless telecom industry. With a focus on innovation, safety, and excellence, we partner with leading providers to build and maintain the networks that keep our world connected. Whether it’s streamlining site acquisition or executing complex construction projects, our talented team is at the forefront of the industry. This role is a full-time, in-office position based out of our Signal Hill, CA headquarters.

We're expanding our Southern California PMO and seeking experienced Project Coordinators at the I, II, and III levels to support our Project Management team on wireless deployments across LA, Orange County, Inland Empire, and San Diego areas. Your level will be determined by your experience, demonstrated ownership of coordination details, and track record supporting project execution.

If you're ready to advance your career with a company that values teamwork, integrity, and your professional development, we want to hear from you! Please complete the online application included in this job posting. If you have any questions, feel free to email us at employment@nuwavecom.com

We are seeking experienced Project Coordinators to support Project Managers and Construction Managers in the day-to-day implementation of wireless telecommunications construction projects, including maintaining project trackers, folders, and documentation; scheduling; coordinating permitting; and supporting the closeout packages (COP). The Project Coordinator ensures policies and procedures for project management are consistently followed and executed, and serves as a key operational partner to the PM, CM, warehouse, subcontractors, and clients. jobs.title: Shelter Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Full Time – Non-Exempt (40 hrs/wk)  
Starting Hourly Rate: $29.33.00 - $31.74/hr

**Make a difference in your community.** Do you believe in working towards justice through your direct advocacy? Do you want to join the team in the efforts towards self-determination, nonviolence practices and violence prevention for the benefit of API communities and those impacted by violence against women? The Center for the Pacific Asian Family is looking for a passionate and committed individual to fit that role!

**Center for the Pacific Asian Family (CPAF)** is a non-profit organization recognized nationally for its pioneering work in domestic violence and sexual assault. CPAF’s multi-lingual and multi-cultural services include a 24-hour hotline, short term and long-term shelters, counseling, case management, and supportive services. CPAF also provides violence prevention programs, outreach, education and advocacy on the issues of family violence and violence against women, focusing on the Asian and Pacific Islander community.

CPAF is a community-based organization that draws from multiple disciplines to holistically serve individuals and families of many different sizes and cultural backgrounds. Staff work in environments where children are present and may be called upon to provide support as needed.

**Summary Statement:**

The Shelter Program Coordinator (SPC) position provides services across both TH Programs (TSN & TSSB) as a non-exempt position working 40 hours a week with domestic violence and sexual assault survivors and reporting to the Shelter Program Manager. Workdays will mainly consist of Monday–Friday, with occasional Saturdays for special events. Work hours will vary between 8am and 8pm, depending on programming and scheduled shifts (opener/closer). The schedule will also consist of one work-from-home day, 2 days at TSN, and 2 days at TSSB.

The SPC works collaboratively with other coordinators, Family Advocates, and the SPM. The SPC is tasked with evaluating the impact of programming for both adults and children. The SPC supports survivors of domestic and sexual violence and their children entering our TH Program through relocation assistance, case management, emotional support, and supportive services. The SPC will also hold a caseload of 4 families at TSSB only and support groups at both sites. The SPC will work closely with the SPM to engage and coordinate interns/volunteers to support the program.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* *Program Development and Implementation:* Collaborate with SPC colleagues to develop, implement, coordinate, and evaluate in-shelter and post-shelter workshops & activities with and for survivors and their children; engage and develop volunteers, interns and community partners to support program activities, including taking the lead on volunteer coordination, language interpretation/translation and engagement; communicate and collaborate with colleague to meet the survivor interests and programmatic needs. Create developmentally appropriate programming for children and youth with a focus on Mommy & Me, Healthy Play/Relationships, Windows Between Worlds, and/or family activities. Coordinate with SPM on adult workshops with a focus on delivering Parenting, DV/SA Workshops, Financial Literacy Workshops, & Career/Employment Workshops.
* *Direct Service:* Work closely with team members when onboarding new survivors and conduct orientation, intake, and assessment of families into the TH program; meet weekly with survivors to develop goal-oriented action plans; provide case management for survivors and their children; provide emotional support/counseling services; provide advocacy and accompaniment to survivors for their legal, court, housing, public benefits, and medical appointments and other meetings as necessary; update Housing Referral Form (HRF), provide safety education, provide resources and referrals to community partners, collaborate with the Housing Coordinator and other relevant team members; and maintain up-to-date files on participants and program activities. Enter EDB notes in a timely manner.
* *Program Administration:* Work with Shelter Program Manager to provide necessary programmatic information by established grant deadlines; work with teammates to ensure relevant forms and files pertaining to residents are complete.
* *Travel requirements:* Driving is an essential job function for this position. A valid CA driver’s license is required if using employee’s own vehicle or agency vehicle to perform duties. The employee must show proof of insurance for own vehicle and must also be eligible for coverage under CPAF’s auto insurance policy.
* *Teamwork:* Provide general support asked of all staff which may include responding to emergencies, site coverage, providing translation, maintaining a functioning office. Participate in program and organizational development and attend staff and team meetings.
* *Outreach:* Identify/create opportunities to be an ambassador for CPAF’s mission.

**Core Competencies/Minimum Standard:** The qualified candidate must demonstrate at least the minimum standard in these core competencies:

* *Communication:* Uses effective written and oral communication with internal staff, teams, and community served; demonstrates empathy and listening.

jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Description:

**OUR MISSION**
===============

Wellness Equity Alliance is a national multidisciplinary health organization that designs and delivers integrated, community-based care for populations most impacted by health inequities. We do this through mobile and field-based models, providing medical care, behavioral health services, substance use treatment, harm reduction, and care coordination in nontraditional settings such as encampments, schools, reentry sites, and rural communities, as well as with sovereign tribal nations. Grounded in trauma-informed, culturally responsive, and data-driven practices, WEA combines clinical expertise, lived experience, and advanced population health analytics to reduce barriers to care, improve continuity, and strengthen local systems. We have partnered with more than 60 public agencies, managed care plans, and community-based organizations across the U.S. to implement scalable, sustainable programs that are advancing health equity and improving outcomes for historically marginalized populations.

We are known as Renegades, Rebels, Disruptors, and Dreamers. If that sounds like you, we want you on our team.

=====================

The Internship Coordinator serves as the organizational hub for all internship, field placement, and training program activities, spanning both undergraduate and graduate-level learners. * MPP – Master of Public Policy

* Ensure program requirements, accreditation standards, and competency frameworks are honored for each degree type (e.g., CEPH for MPH, CSWE for MSW, ACEN/CCNE for MSN, ARC-PA for PA, LCME for MD electives).
* Proactively cultivate new academic partnerships to expand the diversity and pipeline of undergraduate and graduate talent.

jobs.title: Administrative Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Join the forefront of groundbreaking research at the Beckman Research Institute of City of Hope, where we're changing lives and making a real difference in the fight against cancer, diabetes, and other life-threatening illnesses. Our dedicated and compassionate faculty and staff are driven by a common mission: Contribute to innovative approaches in predicting, preventing, and curing diseases, shaping the future of medicine through cutting-edge research.

We are looking for an Administrative Program Coordinator to support the department of Molecular Diagnostics and Experimental Therapeutics (MDET). You will provide high‑level administrative, programmatic, and operational support to senior faculty leadership and departmental programs. The position performs a broad range of complex, diversified, and confidential administrative duties requiring independent judgment, discretion, and a high degree of professionalism. Your responsibilities will include executive calendar and meeting management, coordination of research and academic programs, faculty affairs and recruitment support, financial and business operations assistance, and liaison with internal and external stakeholders.

This role requires exceptional organizational skills, meticulous attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast‑paced, research‑intensive environment. You will serve as a key partner to faculty leadership by anticipating needs, streamlining workflows, and ensuring administrative, compliance, and operational processes are executed efficiently and in alignment with institutional policies. The position requires flexibility, strong communication skills, and the ability to work independently while contributing to the overall success of the department and institution.

**As a successful candidate you will:**

* Provide high-level administrative support to senior faculty leadership, managing complex calendars, meetings, competing priorities, confidential communications, and scheduling needs.
* Coordinate departmental programs, research initiatives, projects, faculty recruitment, and administrative activities supporting academic and institutional goals.
* Manage logistics for research meetings, seminars, symposiums, visitors, and special events, including scheduling, materials, speakers, technology, and travel arrangements.
* Support financial and business operations through budget tracking, purchasing, expense reporting, procurement card reconciliation, account monitoring, and transaction reconciliation.
* Coordinate faculty affairs and HR processes, including appointments, promotions, onboarding/offboarding, Global Scholars Program activities, visa documentation, and compliance requirements.
* Serve as a key liaison for faculty, collaborators, visiting scholars, vendors, and internal departments, supporting recruitment, outreach, and cross-functional communication.
* Maintain faculty and departmental information, including CVs, biosketches, professional profiles, publications, research metrics, websites, reports, databases, shared files, and communications.
* Oversee day-to-day office operations, including workspace coordination, supplies, equipment, facilities requests, visitor logistics, and general administrative workflows.

**Your qualifications should include:**

* Bachelor’s degree. Equivalent experience may substitute for minimum education requirements.
* 3 or more years of experience in business administration, clinical research or healthcare environment

**City of Hope employees pay is based on the following criteria: work experience, qualifications, and work location.**

**City of Hope is an equal opportunity employer.**

**Finance & Operations Coordinator**

Reports To: Deputy Director

Employment Type: Full-Time, Exempt

Compensation: $60,000 **-** 80,000 annually, commensurate with experience

Location: Los Angeles, CA — in-person required for all events and volunteer days; hybrid otherwise

Target Start: November 2026

Direct Reports: None

The Los Angeles Parks Foundation (LAPF) is the primary nonprofit partner of the City of Los Angeles Department of Recreation and Parks (RAP). Founded in 2008, LAPF raises private philanthropic support to enhance, expand, and champion the more than 500 parks and recreation centers stewarded by the City of Los Angeles.

LAPF is in an active growth phase, guided by a new 2026–2030 Strategic Plan and led by President & CEO Amber Martinez. The organization currently operates with a small staff and program and administrative consultants and is building toward a full operational team. The Administration & Grants Coordinator is a foundational hire — the role that keeps the day-to-day running smoothly so that program and development staff can focus on mission-driven work.

The Finance and Operations Coordinator supports the financial and operational functions of LAPF under the direction of the Deputy Director. This role is the organizational engine behind LAPF’s day-to-day administration: processing transactions, maintaining records, managing office systems, supporting the external accountant, and ensuring that the organization’s financial and operational infrastructure runs accurately and on time.

LAPF works with an external accountant for bookkeeping and tax filings. The Finance and Operations Coordinator is the internal point of contact for that relationship, gathering documentation, processing receipts and invoices, and ensuring the accountant has what they need to produce clean and timely financial reports. The Deputy Director reviews financial statements and manages the budget; this role supports that process with accurate, well-organized underlying data.

This is a detail-oriented, systems-minded role in a small, mission-driven organization. The right person takes pride in accurate records, well-run processes, and a tidy office — and finds satisfaction in being the person the rest of the team can count on to keep things organized.

Time is allocated across four functional areas as follows:

Area % Focus

**Operations and Office Administration 30%**

Invoice processing, receipts, reimbursements, 12% fee tracking, external accountant support

**Financial Administration & Payment Processing 35%**

Accounts payable, Bill.com payments, reimbursements, revenue documentation, administrative fee tracking, external accountant coordination, grant expenditure tracking, and audit support

**Grants, Accounts & Reporting Processing 20%**

Friends of Parks and Special Projects administration, grant deliverables and reporting deadlines, CRM and donor records, account reporting, and data management

**Board and Executive Support 15%**

Board and committee coordination, drafting materials and minutes, organizational scheduling and meeting logistics,

**1. Operations and Office Administration (30%)**

The Finance and Operations Coordinator is responsible for the day-to-day administration of LAPF’s office and internal operations, ensuring that staff have the systems supplies, equipment, and administrative support needed to work effectively. This role serves as the primary point person for routine office operations and proactively identifies and resolves administrative needs.

* Manage day-to-day office operations at the Griffith Park Nursery House, including supplies, equipment, mail, shared spaces, and other administrative needs.

* Monitor office supply inventory, place orders, and ensure supplies and shared resources are organized and readily available to staff.
* Coordinate maintenance, repair, and replacement of office equipment and technology; maintain an accurate inventory of computers, devices, and other Foundation equipment.
* Serve as the first point of contact for routine technology and IT needs and coordinate more complex issues with LAPF's external IT provider.
* Coordinate employee onboarding and offboarding logistics, including equipment, workstations, system access, email/accounts, keys, and other administrative needs.
* Manage incoming and outgoing mail and packages and maintain LAPF's physical and electronic mailboxes.
* Coordinate routine facilities needs and serve as the Foundation's administrative point of contact for issues related to the Griffith Park Nursery House.
* Maintain organizational calendars and coordinate internal scheduling and meeting logistics as directed by the Deputy Director.
* Maintain shared administrative systems and organizational files, ensuring current contracts, agreements, insurance certificates, policies, and other key documents are organized and accessible.
* Support logistical needs for Foundation events, Board meetings, and volunteer activities, including ordering supplies, coordinating deliveries, and assisting with setup and breakdown.
* Identify opportunities to improve administrative processes, document recurring procedures, and help implement systems that make LAPF's operations more efficient and consistent.

**2. Financial Administration and Payment Processing (35%)**

The Finance and Operations Coordinator facilitates LAPF's day-to-day financial administration and payment processes, maintaining accurate and complete documentation for the Deputy Director and external accountant and helping ensure transactions are processed efficiently and in accordance with Foundation policies.

**JOB SUMMARY:**

The Retail Production Coordinator is responsible for order processing, which involves entering orders into the company's ERP system, procuring the necessary components to fulfill retail orders, collaborating with the AP team, and working with the Retail sales team to ensure prompt and efficient order fulfillment.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES**

In a fast-paced and growing environment like ours, priorities and projects often change so this role includes, but is not limited to, the following responsibilities:

**Order Processing & Procurement**

* Enter purchase orders (POs) and sales orders (SOs) into Microsoft Dynamics Business Central and coordinate purchase order (PO) submission with vendors.
* Maintain and update the Production WIP/tracker with all essential information related to retail purchase orders, and other relevant initiatives.
* Ensure timely and accurate purchase, logging, tracking, and confirmation of order components at the factory level (e.g., hang tags, size strips, price tags).

* Collaborate with the Pre-Production Coordinator to confirm accurate factory costs, components, and allocations before order processing.

* Support month-end accounting procedures, including PO receipt processing in the Microsoft Dynamics Business Central clearing maintenance repair and operations (MRO) entries, and transferring blanks scraps to designated locations.
* Work with the Accounting Department to facilitate financial transactions, including delivery notes, credit memos, and vendor payments.

**Process Optimization & Reporting**

jobs.title: Territory Account Manager (Clinical Outreach)
jobs.description:
**Job Title****:** Territory Account Manager (Clinical Outreach)

**Location****:** Long Beach, CA (full-time; onsite)

**Pay****:** $85,000/year + Incentive Bonus Plan

*This posting is an evergreen position, and we are always on the lookout for talented people to join our team. While we may not have a current opening, we are continually building a talent pool of qualified candidates for future opportunities. As our organization grows, we encourage candidates who are passionate about delivering high-quality patient care to express their interest. We value innovation, collaboration, and excellence, and we look forward to connecting with professionals who share our commitment to making a meaningful impact.*

**About Us:**

Founded in 2015, the Food Allergy Institute (FAI) is a cutting-edge research and clinical care center revolutionizing food allergy treatment among the pediatric population. Our Tolerance Induction Program™ is the first of its kind, bringing patients to the point where they can eat whatever they want, whenever they want, without having to worry about any kind of reaction. The success of FAI is built on years of development involving proprietary biomarkers, data analytics and modeling systems which allow unique patient specific therapy to be deployed in the clinic setting and at home safely.

**Why Join FAI?**

The Food Allergy Institute (FAI) is home to innovative thinkers, problem solvers, and passionate leaders who are transforming the world of food allergy treatment. Our work is life-changing for patients and their families, and every member of our team plays a vital role in supporting our mission. With over 180 employees, Our diverse team includes Physicians in the specialties of Pediatrics, Pulmonary, Allergy & Immunology, Emergency Medicine, as well as Nurse Practitioners, Physicians Assistants, and a PhD level research team. In the food allergy world, the growth of FAI is unique in reflecting the effectiveness of its treatment approach and the supportive environment fostered by its team of professionals.

At FAI, you'll be part of a team dedicated to making a real impact. We provide access to cutting-edge technology, offer competitive salaries, comprehensive benefits, and endless opportunities for professional development and career growth. Join us in transforming food allergy care and be inspired to make a difference.

**Who Are We Looking For?**

We are seeking a Territory Account Manager (Clinical Outreach) to build, strengthen, and expand our referral network in the Los Angeles and Orange County areas by cultivating meaningful relationships with physicians, medical practices, and provider groups. As the primary point of contact for referring providers in Southern California, this individual will promote clinical services, facilitate education, and ensure seamless communication between practices and the organization. The Medical Liaison will also collaborate with leadership to identify strategic opportunities, support Affiliate Provider development, and drive community engagement through outreach, clinic tours, and events. By fostering trust and collaboration across the medical community, this role plays a vital part in advancing patient referrals, enhancing provider partnerships, and supporting the organization’s overall growth.

***This is an onsite position that involves travel between different clinic and community locations throughout their assigned region.***

**Key Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain relationships with medical practices, providers, and clinical office staff to strengthen the referral network, including identifying and engaging physicians for advanced training opportunities with our team.
* Cultivate relationships with clinical practices, medical groups, and provider networks, facilitating introductions to leadership and our practice management committee for strategic partnership and growth opportunities.
* Expand the referral funnel by actively engaging community physicians through office visits, clinic tours, and participation in community events.
* Provide physicians with education and resources on anaphylaxis management, clinical programs, and digital patient education tools.
* Identify and recommend physicians for Affiliate Provider opportunities and support leadership in developing these partnerships to advance patient recruitment and clinical billing activities at Affiliate Clinic sites.
* Conduct regular in-person visits and check-ins with physician offices to provide updates, address concerns, and strengthen partnerships.
* Promote the organization’s clinical services, specialties, and programs to community physicians.
* Develop and implement strategies to increase patient referrals and expand market presence.
* Serve as a resource for physicians and office staff, ensuring seamless communication and resolution of issues related to referrals, scheduling, and patient experience.
* Collaborate with internal leadership, marketing, and clinical teams to align outreach efforts with organizational goals.
* Track and report referral patterns, relationship activity, and business development outcomes.
* Stay informed on competitor activity, industry trends, and market opportunities.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Healthcare Administration, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 2+ years of experience in pharmaceutical sales, physician relations, healthcare business development, or a related healthcare sales role preferred.
* Strong interpersonal, relationship-building, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently, manage time effectively, and prioritize outreach activities.
* Knowledge of healthcare services, referral processes, and medical practice operations is strongly preferred.
* Proficiency with Google Suite and CRM or referral management software.
* Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation for travel to physician offices.
* Professional

------------

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. jobs.title: Operations Assistant
jobs.description:
The Operations Assistant plays a critical role in maintaining the speed, accuracy, and reliability of day-to-day terminal operations. This position exists to ensure freight flows without disruption, operational data remains accurate in real time, and cross-functional teams are aligned on execution.  
  
In a fast-moving logistics environment, even small delays or communication gaps can create downstream inefficiencies. This role directly mitigates those risks by owning load visibility, coordinating with multiple internal and external stakeholders, and ensuring operational systems reflect ground truth.  
  
Success in this role means shipments move predictably, exceptions are identified and escalated early, and the service center operates with precision, accountability, and minimal rework.

**What you’ll do**
==================

**1. Drive operational coordination and load visibility**
---------------------------------------------------------

* Track outbound loads daily and ensure system updates are accurate and timely
* Proactively communicate delays to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders before 11 AM
* Monitor pickup schedules and investigate loads that have not departed by 10 AM
* Escalate operational risks and delays to Linehaul and leadership with clear context

**2. Execute administrative and documentation workflows**
---------------------------------------------------------

* Manage driver documentation, including IC paperwork, plates, IFTA, and compliance materials
* Collect and route maintenance records to Safety to ensure compliance standards are met
* Manifest inbound and outbound freight, ensuring documentation accuracy across systems
* File and maintain exception reports and operational records

jobs.description:
**About Critical Loop**

Critical Loop is shaping the next generation of energy systems by building the integrated edge grid of the future. Specializing in advanced energy management and battery control systems, Critical Loop empowers businesses and communities to seamlessly unite distributed energy resources for faster, more reliable, and affordable grid access. With deep expertise in grid modernization and a passion for creating resilient, responsive energy solutions, Critical Loop drives innovation at the intersection of technology and energy.

**The Role**

We are hiring an Operations & Logistics Coordinator to support the deployment and day-to-day operation of our mobile battery energy storage systems and other distributed energy assets.

This role will own much of the coordination required to move equipment to and from customer sites, manage rental and transportation vendors, maintain accurate site and asset records, support receiving and warehouse activities, and keep operational and maintenance documentation organized.

This is a hands-on, onsite role that combines logistics coordination, operational administration, and practical field support. You will work closely with our Operations Engineers, Projects, Sales, Accounting, and external vendors to make sure equipment, records, and services are where they need to be when they need to be there.

We are looking for someone who is highly organized, follows through reliably, and is comfortable handling both administrative work and practical onsite tasks.

**What You Will Do**

* Coordinate transportation, delivery, retrieval, and staging of batteries, generators, trailers, and other equipment for customer deployments

* Track equipment rentals, delivery schedules, vendor commitments, and open logistics items
* Support review and reconciliation of rental invoices, fuel deliveries, and other operational costs
* Maintain accurate site, asset, vendor, rental, and operational records in systems such as Salesforce, Odoo, and other internal tools
* Keep maintenance records, service history, and equipment documentation organized and up to date
* Receive packages, freight, and equipment deliveries at our Long Beach facility

* Track open issues and follow up with vendors and internal stakeholders until they are resolved
* Support site mobilizations and demobilizations by confirming equipment, transportation, vendor, and delivery requirements
* Help identify discrepancies in records, invoices, deliveries, serial numbers, schedules, or other operational information
* Support Operations Engineers and project teams with ad hoc logistics and administrative needs
* Occasionally travel locally to vendors, customer sites, DMV offices, or other locations as required

**Must-Haves**

* Experience coordinating construction logistics, equipment rentals, fleet, field service, or similar physical operations
* Strong organization and follow-through across multiple concurrent tasks, vendors, and deadlines
* Comfortable working onsite and performing hands-on tasks including receiving freight, warehouse support, material handling, and local errands
* Clear written and verbal communication with vendors and internal stakeholders
* Basic spreadsheet and data competency, including comfort reviewing invoices, fuel deliveries, rental charges, and operational records

**Nice-to-Haves**

* Familiarity with BESS, generators, electrical equipment, or other industrial power systems
* Experience with Salesforce, Odoo, ERP, CMMS, inventory, fleet-management, or similar systems
* Experience reviewing vendor invoices, purchase orders, fuel records, or other operational expenses
* Experience maintaining fleet, equipment, or maintenance records
* Forklift certification or prior material-handling experience; willingness to obtain certification is sufficient

**Work Authorization:** Critical Loop does not provide visa sponsorship for this role. Please do not apply for this role if at any time (now or in the future) you will need immigration support (i.e H-1B / OPT training plans etc.).

jobs.description:
Los Angeles, California / Annual / Full time

The Best Friend's Mission is to do nothing short of making history by bringing about a time when there are No More Homeless Pets. Our goal is that every animal shelter in every community in the country be no kill.

The fact is, we have a great culture, populated by fun, dedicated, and brilliant people. But we're always looking for talented people who can help us make history, and that's where you come in. **If you want to be a part of history and end the killing of pets in shelters, apply today for one of our open job opportunities!**

**Location:** 1845 Pontius Ave Los Angeles, CA 90025

**Hiring Range:** This position’s hiring range is anticipated to be $73,000-$80,000 annually, depending on experience, plus great benefits!

***This is a temporary position expected to last 1 year from hire date.***

  

**Position Summary:**

Best Friends Animal Society is on a mission to end the killing of dogs and cats in America's shelters. In Los Angeles, that mission comes to life through the stories of the pets we meet, both at our Pet Adoption Center and with the shelters and rescue groups we partner with across the region.

This role captures those stories: pets who need fosters, pets ready for adoption, and pets who've found their homes. You'll be behind the camera for all of it, at the Center and out in the field with our partners.

  

**Culture Statement and Responsibility:** We believe in treating everyone with kindness and compassion, building trust through authenticity and following through on commitments. We prioritize well-being alongside our mission, fostering strong relationships through open communication and transparent feedback. Diversity and inclusion are integral to our culture, enriching team dynamics by valuing diverse perspectives. Each team member is responsible for creating an inclusive environment where all voices are respected and contributing to a workplace that embodies our shared values and commitment to progress. By consistently aligning our actions with our Guiding Principles, we strengthen our culture and ensure that our values are lived every day.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

  

* **Capture and Create Content Across LA and Community Partners:** As part of the LA marketing team, capture photo and video content at the LA Pet Adoption Center, at events, and onsite with community partner organizations, including local shelters and rescue groups, covering pets who need fosters, pets available for adoption, and pets who've found homes. Partner with the Programs team to find and develop the next story.

* **Edit and Produce Ready-to-Post Content:** Edit raw photo and video into content that's on-brand but still feels real, not overproduced. Know what makes a strong shot and how to edit it into something worth posting.

* **Post Content and Track What's Working:** Post content to Instagram and Facebook as part of the LA team's social presence, staying on top of platform trends. Use performance and analytics tools to see what's resonating and apply what you learn to future content.

* **Support Media and Influencer Relationships:** Work with the National social media team to identify and coordinate with influencers, whether they come from local connections or get routed through National. Help manage on-site visits and content when influencers come to the LA Pet Adoption Center or partner locations. Work with the local and national PR teams to facilitate media opportunities on and off site, appearing on camera to represent the Best Friends brand as needed.

* **Moderate Comments and Engage with Our Community:** Monitor and respond to comments and messages across Instagram and Facebook in a timely, on-brand voice. Flag anything that needs a closer look from the team.

  

**Skills and Experience:**

  

* **Content Creation, Storytelling & Editing:** 2-4 years shooting and editing both static and video content, with a strong eye for composition, lighting and narrative storytelling. Comfortable with editing tools, and you know how to turn raw footage into something ready to post.

* **Social Media Experience:** 2-4 years working in social media or content roles, with hands on experience posting to Instagram and Facebook and a solid understanding of how each platform works.

* **Trend Awareness:** You pay attention to what's working on social media and bring fresh ideas instead of waiting to be told what to post.

* **Pet Content Experience:** Experience creating content featuring animals is a plus, not required.

* **Cultural Fluency:** Comfortable creating content for LA's diverse audiences. Spanish bilingual skills are a plus, not required.

* **Cross-Team Collaboration:** Comfortable working across teams, Programs, National social, local partners, and adjusting as priorities shift.
  

**Physical Requirements:**

  

* Lift up to 40 pounds and perform daily strenuous activity including, but not limited to lifting, carrying, reaching, stooping, squatting, cleaning, and bending.
* Perform repetitive tasks for extended periods of time including typing, sitting, walking, arm, and hand motion.
* Work indoors and outdoors in a variety of weather conditions including extreme heat and cold.
* Comfort working in and around active shelter environments, including facilities where animals are at risk. This is the reality of rescue work, and it’s what drives everything we do.
* Must have a valid driver's license that has been in good standing for at least 3 years, ability to qualify to be added to Best Friends insurance.
* Ability to travel within the Los Angeles area

Method Technologies is looking for our first dedicated Solutions Advisor!

We're looking for someone who enjoys meeting new people, starting conversations, building relationships, and creating opportunities.

You'll spend your time meeting business leaders, attending networking events, conducting discovery meetings, developing opportunities, preparing proposals, presenting recommendations, and helping businesses solve problems.

**Planning & Execution:** Exceptional time management, organization, and independent decision-making skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities effectively.

You will take ownership of your territory by maintaining a productive client engagement schedule, developing new business, expanding existing accounts, and advancing project opportunities. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

Ø Ensures that proper inventory levels are maintained and/or procured to allow production work to be performed on schedule to meet delivery commitments.

Ø Monitors customers inventory levels, modifying sales orders as needed to support customer’s needs.

Ø Procures all needed raw material and hardware, monitors purchase orders status as needed

Ø Reviews sales order material requirements and identifies shortages. Follows up with purchasing and contracts to clear shortages.

Ø Monitors incoming material as it is received and determines schedule for the issuance of corresponding work orders to production departments as prompted by production schedule data contained in the company's MRP computer system.

Ø Coordinates "split" work orders as needed or directed, completing all corresponding documentation. Reschedules or combines work orders with similar or identical operations to run concurrently to eliminate duplicate machine setups and other redundancy or waste.

Ø Regularly monitors status of work in progress, and expedites when necessary, to ensure timely completion in accordance with the production work schedule.

Ø Makes production schedule adjustments or revisions as necessary, based on work order specifications, established priorities, and the availability of production capacity and material resources.

Ø Regularly updates and monitors work schedule lists and reports as required. Apprises management, production and support personnel as necessary.

Ø Responds promptly to contracts/sales inquiries and requests for work order status, providing accurate information as needed.

Ø Presents operating reports to senior management. Creates timelines for product deliveries if needed.

Ø Meets established standards for productivity and quality. Confers with supervisor when problems arise which impact expected level of performance.

Ø Responsible for supporting and ensuring compliance to ISO 9002/AS9100 Quality Management Systems.

Ø Must contribute to a positive work environment.

Ø Performs any task required to support customer requirements and company goals.

Ø Associate's degree (A. A.) or equivalent from two-year college or technical school; or five or more years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Ø Ability to read, analyze, and interpret professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations.

Ø Must possess strong interpersonal written and verbal communication skills.

Ø Excellent computer skills with working knowledge of Microsoft Office tools, ERP / MRP systems, word processing and spreadsheet programs.

Ø Ability to work positively and constructively in a team environment.

Ø Must consistently demonstrate professional and pleasant behavior and communicate effectively and appropriately in stressful situations and environments.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**

Ø Must be able to sit for up to 10 hours per day.

Ø Frequently required to stand and walk.

Ø Must occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds.

Ø Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
One Getty Values: Getty is committed to creating a welcoming workplace that reflects the various backgrounds of the communities we serve. We value differences in the pursuit of inquiry and knowledge, mutual understanding, respect, trust, transparency, and cooperation. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship or immigration status, color, disability, ethnicity, familial status, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, national origin, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other protected status. Job Summary:

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a highly organized and proactive professional to serve as Executive Assistant to the John E. and Louise Bryson Director of the Getty Conservation Institute. This position oversees day-to-day operations for the director’s office and provides high-level administrative and operational support. The Executive Assistant is key in managing priorities and communications, coordinating activities, and ensuring the efficient functioning of the office in support of the Director’s priorities and the Institute’s mission.

**About Us**

The Getty Conservation Institute is dedicated to finding ways to improve conservation of the world’s cultural heritage—its art objects, museum collections, historic buildings, and archaeological sites and our work often takes place at heritage sites across the globe including locations in South America, Asia, and the Middle East, where we work in partnership with heritage professionals from the region. Our staff have expertise in architecture, archaeology, conservation, engineering, chemistry, materials science, physics, information science, operations management, administration, and communications.

This job will be based in our office at the Getty Center in Los Angeles. It will begin in the office full-time and the opportunity to request a telework schedule may be available after an initial period of training and orientation and will be discussed and approved by your supervisor. Typically, staff with approved telework schedules at the Getty Conservation Institute are in the office more than half of the time.

Major Job Responsibilities:

As the Executive Assistant, you will:

* Proactively manage the director’s attention and focus by anticipating needs, clarifying priorities, and ensuring that the director’s time is directed to the most important issues.
* Manage a complex executive calendar, involving competing requests and multiple scheduling priorities.
* Track inquiries received by the director via email, phone, and mail to ensure timely responses; and maintain director’s database of colleagues’ contact information.
* Coordinate all aspects of the director’s national and international business travel arrangements, which also includes preparation of briefing materials and background information for meetings and trips, and timely completion of expense reports in compliance with Getty policies.
* Maintain the director’s office records in accordance with institutional records management policies. This work regularly involves records of enduring value that document the organization's history and requires preservation of such materials and Getty intellectual property.
* Organize internal and external events of various sizes, which may include venue, catering, technology, and audio-visual arrangements.
* Develop agendas, notes, minutes, and other communications on behalf of the director, including drafting and proofreading correspondence, reports, publications, and presentations, including light editing of images.
* Gather, evaluate, and synthesize information from multiple sources to develop written briefing materials for the director, as requested.
* Process contracts and payments, prepare and track the director’s office budget, procure supplies, implement special projects requested by the director, and perform other duties as assigned.
* Represent the Getty Conservation Institute and the director’s office with professionalism, discretion, and sound judgment in interactions inside and outside Getty.
* Serve as a trusted ambassador who is capable of safeguarding and strengthening key relationships with peers, senior leaders, trustees, donors, and partners.

In all aspects of your responsibilities, you will work under the general direction of the director while exercising independence and sound judgment on the director’s behalf to address complex, sensitive, or ambiguous issues and make decisions in a fast-paced environment.

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree and a minimum of 7 years of related experience, including experience providing executive-level support

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

* Ability to thrive and remain composed in a fast-paced work environment.
* Able to recognize when to act independently and when to consult the director.
* Excellent problem-solving, capable of resolving complex issues or identifying well-considered solutions for the director.
* Strategic prioritization and exemplary judgment. Able to understand the office’s priorities and make sound decisions about where the director’s attention is needed.
* Proactive in identifying the director’s needs and external challenges before they become pressing.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Effective communications skills, both written and verbal; ability to proofread.
* High level of discretion.
* Demonstrated success in planning, organizing and completing projects.
* Self-motivated, able to anticipate emerging tasks.
* Able to balance your own workload between shifting demands and routine office operations.

Must be proficient in Microsoft Office applications (including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint and OneDrive); familiarity with Blackbaud Raiser’s Edge, and photo editing software

jobs.title: Business Operations Lead
jobs.description:
Rivian is seeking a Business Operations Lead to serve as the intelligence layer between the Customer Analytics and Sales & Delivery leadership. This role owns the source of truth for all performance KPIs reported by Sales & Delivery — ensuring the data is clean, consistent, and presented in a way that provides actionable insight and drives decision-making.

This is not an analyst role. It is designed for someone who can move fluently between data and narrative, assess performance across site, regional, and portfolio levels simultaneously, and connect macro business trends to the micro-level patterns playing out across individual teams and locations. Success in this role requires strong analytical judgment, a sharp editorial instinct, and the ability to tell a clear story with data to an executive audience.

  

* Maintain the source of truth for all Sales & Delivery performance KPIs — defining metrics, governing definitions, and ensuring consistency across dashboards, reports, and leadership communications
* Serve as the primary liaison to the Customer Analytics organization, translating operational and executive needs into dashboard and reporting requirements and ensuring outputs are clean, accessible, and decision-ready
* Identify performance trends across site, regional, and portfolio levels — connecting macro dynamics to micro-level patterns and surfacing insights before they become compounding problems
* Translate performance data into clear, actionable recommendations for Sales & Delivery leadership, with diagnosis, root cause, and a suggested path forward
* Own the analytical narrative in executive presentations, briefs, WBRs, QBRs, and leadership reviews — not just the charts, but the story they tell and the decisions they should drive
* Monitor data integrity across all reporting surfaces, identifying inconsistencies, flagging gaps, and driving resolution with the Customer Analytics team to maintain a single version of the truth
* Build and maintain performance visibility frameworks that give site leaders, regional leaders, and executives the right level of insight for their scope of accountability
* Partner with Analytics, Finance, Sales Operations, and Field Leadership to align on KPI definitions, ensure consistent application across the organization, and evolve the metrics framework as the business scales

  

* 6+ years in retail analytics, sales analytics, commercial performance insights, or a similarly data-intensive commercial role
* Experience in automotive, retail, or other consumer-facing commercial operations preferred
* Experience owning KPI frameworks and governing metric definitions across complex, multi-stakeholder organizations
* Demonstrated ability to assess performance at site, regional, and portfolio levels — and connect macro trends to micro-level outcomes across a distributed organization
* Fluency in data visualization tools such as Tableau, Hex, or similar, with experience shaping dashboard design and working directly with analytics or data engineering teams
* Familiarity with Salesforce or similar CRM operations and analytics tooling preferred
* Proven ability to translate business questions into analytical requirements and analytical findings back into business language
* Strong narrative instincts: you don't just surface data, you build the story behind it clearly enough that executives can act on it
* Exceptional written communication and presentation skills — you build executive-ready materials that are clear, well-structured, and decision-oriented

jobs.title: Bilingual Program Coordinator Direct Service
jobs.description:
**Are you a skilled professional who believes in lending your skills to end hunger during these unprecedented times? If so, consider being the** **Bilingual Program Coordinator, Direct Service** **for the San Francisco-Marin Food Bank.** Join our friendly, collaborative, and hardworking programs team, reporting to the Program Supervisor.

The Bilingual Program Coordinator, Direct Service is responsible for providing onsite support at our staff-led Community Markets. This is a fixed term position anticipated to end June 30, 2028.

Who We Are:

**Our mission** is to end hunger in San Francisco and Marin.

**We envision** a just and equitable society that nurtures a resilient community. We envision a community where everyone will have access to nutritious food of their choosing and will be uplifted by a network of support. We work with our community to create lasting solutions to address both the hunger we see today and the root causes that perpetuate food insecurity in our society. Every week, over 50,000 households count on us for food assistance. 60% of what we distribute is fresh fruits and vegetables.

Who You Are:

To excel in this position, you will need to approach the work with the following habits and values:

* **Collaboration and Teamwork:** Partners with others to get work done. Gains trust and support of others. Does own fair share of the work. Seeks assistance from other team members, as needed. Volunteers assistance and undertakes additional tasks to support others. Acknowledges colleagues accomplishments and shares credit on collaborative work.
* **Values Differences/Embraces Inclusion and Diversity:** Seeks to understand different perspectives and cultures. Contributes to a work climate where differences are valued and supported and want to do their best. Self-aware and considerate of how bias, poor treatment and conflict is handled and demonstrates valuing others. Is sensitive to cultural norms, expectations and ways of communicating.
* **Customer Focus/Service Orientation:** Collaborates with colleagues to deliver high-quality service. Actively listens and asks questions to determine participant/volunteer needs. Suggests ways to improve the participant experience. Demonstrates values of caring, respect, honesty, and responsibility in all interacting with staff, volunteers, and participants. Establishes and maintains effective participant/volunteer relationships.
* **Judgement:** Considers the long-term as well as immediate short-term outcomes and actions. Recognizes when to escalate appropriate of specific situations to the next higher level of expertise. Considers alternative available actions, resources, and constraints before selecting a method for accomplishing a task or project. Confirms details before deciding how to act. Seeks out others to check or review their own work for accuracy and completeness. Reviews all relevant information or aspects of a situation before acting or deciding.
* **Self-Awareness and Professionalism:** Reflects on activities and impact on others. Proactively seeks feedback without being defensive. Is open to criticism and talking about shortcomings. Admits mistakes and gains insight from experiences. Is conscious of an manages how ones actions and reactions impact others. Knows strengths, weaknesses, opportunities and limits. Knows how to conduct self in the workplace: communicates effectively, resolves conflict, does not gossip, acts with integrity, and holds professional boundaries.
* **Delivers Commitments:** Follows through on commitments. Acts with a clear sense of ownership. Takes personal responsibility for decisions, actions and failures. Are seen as direct and truthful. Solves issues, rather than focusing on blame. Identifies and communicates what they need of others, and shares that with them directly and professionally.

What You Would Be Accountable for:

The Bilingual Program Coordinator, Direct Services will be responsible for the following key pieces of work:

* Program implementation: site set up, product receipt, operation, safety and clean-up.
* Volunteer management: train, assign roles and ensure best practices are being followed.
* Site environment: distributions are welcoming and provide a positive experience for everyone.
* Participant support: effectively communicate information and use technology to streamline and track program implementation.

What You Would Be Doing Right Now:

* Provide onsite support at our staff-led Community Markets: volunteer management, grocery distribution, choice management, participant support, and support the co-location with support services.
* Ensure food availability at community markets through food 'ordering', inventory management, and assessment of product movement
* Complete administrative responsibilities, including communicating pertinent information to team members, creating market signage, developing participant written communications, reporting attendance and food inventory, and communicating with participants via ZenDesk.
* Maintain required job knowledge, skills and core competencies. Attend and engage in required trainings and team meetings.
* Represent the Food Bank in the community by engaging with participants, volunteers, partners, and community members.
* Assist in resolving complex and sensitive customer service issues, either in person, by phone, or in writing; maintain records/documentation of customer service issues and/or involve leadership to ensure appropriate resolution
* Support other programs with direct service and/or administrative responsibilities, as needed.
* Ability to work some evenings and weekends
* Perform other duties, as assigned.

What Else You Should Know:

**All internal candidates must apply using their Food Bank work email within 10 business days of posting to be considered. Applications submitted after 10 days are still welcome but may not be reviewed or afforded an interview, depending on the status of the selection process.**

**PREFERRED

jobs.title: Event Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**About Bobyard**
-----------------

Construction is a multi-trillion-dollar industry that still estimates by hand. Contractors measure and count materials off drawings manually, and it caps how many jobs they can bid. Bobyard uses computer vision and NLP to automate takeoffs and estimates, so contractors bid faster and win more. We raised a $35M Series A led by 8VC, with Primary and Pear, and we're growing fast.

**About the role**

Contractors buy from people they've met, and a lot of those meetings happen on a trade show floor. You'll own Bobyard's events program across the trades we serve: landscaping, electrical, mechanical, concrete, and more. You'll set our events strategy, decide which events are worth it, run the biggest ones yourself, and report what each one returned in meetings and pipeline. You'll partner closely with sales, and plans will change often. The work is physical and show weeks are long. The payoff is knowing exactly which events win us customers.

**What you'll do**

* Set the events strategy and annual calendar, tier every event, and set a meetings target for each one before we sign
* Own the event budget and negotiate sponsorships, booth space, and vendor contracts
* Run booth logistics end to end: exhibitor deadlines, shipping, booth build, staffing, and on-site execution
* Work with our SDRs and AEs to book meetings before every show and staff the booth with the right people
* Get every lead into HubSpot and in front of the right rep within 48 hours of the show closing
* Report what each event cost and returned to leadership, and decide which events to drop, keep, or expand
* Write the playbook so each show runs faster than the last

**What we're looking for**

* 4+ years in event marketing or field marketing at a B2B company, including owning an events strategy and budget
* You've run 12 or more events a quarter, from major booths to walk-the-floor shows, contract to follow-up
* You've managed an event budget and can tell us the cost per meeting for shows you ran
* You work well with sales, including when they push back on your plan
* Strong vendor management and contract negotiation
* Calm under pressure. A crate goes missing at 6am and the booth still opens on time. The plan changes the night before and you adjust.
* Comfortable traveling about 30%, often to convention centers for several days at a time

**Nice to have**

* Construction, trades, or industrial trade show experience
* Experience routing event leads in HubSpot or Salesforce
* Experience bringing customers to the booth or onto a speaking panel
* Experience as the first or only events hire at a startup

**What we offer**

* $120K–$140K base + equity (4-year vest, 1-year cliff)
* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* 401(k) with a 100% match up to 4%
* Catered lunch in the office and $70 a month toward your commute
* A calendar and budget that are yours to shape, with results our leadership reads

**Location**

Full-time, in person at our San Francisco office (101 2nd Street), 4 days a week.  
  
**On sponsorship**

We are not able to sponsor work visas for this role at this time.

**Comp Philosophy**

Cash for stability. Bonus for performance. Equity for ownership. Your package reflects your role, your experience, and what you deliver.

Compensation Range: $120K - $140K

Core Solutions branches offer construction equipment rentals including aerial equipment, earth moving equipment, material handling equipment and more.

Whether you're behind the wheel, under the hood, leading a branch, or closing deals — tech supports *you*, and you drive *us* forward.

See challenges as opportunities  

Embrace change and continuous improvement

At EquipmentShare, we believe the best solutions come from a team that reflects the world around us. **About Bobyard**
  
Construction is a multi-trillion-dollar industry that still estimates by hand. Contractors measure and count materials off drawings manually, and it caps how many jobs they can bid. Bobyard uses computer vision and NLP to automate takeoffs and estimates, so contractors bid faster and win more. We raised a $35M Series A led by 8VC, with Primary and Pear, and we're growing fast.

**About the role**
  
You'll be our first legal hire and the point person for everything legal at Bobyard. Today, legal work is spread across our leadership team and five outside law firms, and your job is to bring it into one place. You'll negotiate customer agreements, keep our contracts and terms current, and manage the firms we work with. Success is Sales never waiting on legal, and every matter having one owner and a clear next step.

**What you'll do**

* Be the single point of contact for legal requests: triage, route, and track every matter to closure
* Negotiate and redline customer agreements (MSAs, order forms, DPAs, and NDAs) within our playbook, and escalate what needs outside counsel
* Manage our outside counsel relationships, scope matters, and track legal spend
* Keep contract templates current and version-controlled as pricing and processes change
* Work with Product to keep our terms of service, privacy policy, and in-product terms accurate
* Analyze contract terms against data-privacy, security, and commercial risk, and give leadership clear recommendations
* Build the systems that make legal scale: intake, a clause playbook, and contract management

**What we're looking for**

* 0–3 years in legal operations, commercial contracts, or a transactional practice
* You've redlined or negotiated contracts yourself, not just watched
* You make a call with incomplete information, and you know when to escalate
* You can say no to a salesperson or a customer's lawyer and keep the relationship strong
* Clear, concise writing, and the follow-through to keep many matters moving at once

**Nice to have**

* Juris Doctor (JD)
* Admitted to the California bar
* SaaS agreements, DPAs, or privacy frameworks (GDPR, CCPA). CIPP/US is a plus
* Contract lifecycle management (CLM) tools
* Startup experience, or a firm serving startups

**What we offer**

**About Ramp**
==============

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

**About the Role**
------------------

Ramp’s Sales organization is looking for self-motivated teammates who are excited to learn the craft of outbound selling and help accelerate our growth. As an SMB Sales Development Representative, you will be an early point of contact for prospective customers by researching, engaging, and qualifying finance leaders at growing businesses.

This is a foundational sales role for early-career talent. You will build prospecting, discovery, messaging, and account-prioritization skills through structured training, coaching, feedback, and repetition.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Source new sales opportunities through inbound qualification and outbound outreach.
* Research companies, prioritize accounts, and identify the right prospects to contact.
* Build thoughtful phone, email, and multi-channel campaigns that create relevant conversations with finance leaders.
* Qualify prospects through consultative discovery and uncover business challenges before positioning Ramp.
* Clearly explain how Ramp can help finance teams simplify spend management, reduce manual work, and gain visibility and control.
* Maintain accurate prospect and activity data in Salesforce and other sales tools.
* Use AI and other tools thoughtfully to improve research, personalization, and workflow efficiency; validate outputs before using them.
* Use coaching, data, and feedback to improve performance and contribute qualified pipeline.

**What You’ll Need**
--------------------

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and concisely.
* Curiosity about business challenges and how finance teams operate.
* Comfort in a fast-paced, high-volume environment that includes repetition, feedback, and rejection.
* A builder mindset: you spot friction, create simple improvements, learn from results, and adapt quickly.
* Demonstrated coachability and willingness to ask for help, practice, and improve.
* Practical AI fluency and sound judgment when using tools to improve work quality and speed.
* A genuine interest in beginning a sales career and building foundational outbound skills.

**Nice to Haves**

* Customer-facing, sales, fundraising, service, or leadership experience.
* Experience working toward goals, metrics, or performance targets.
* Familiarity with CRM, outreach, or productivity tools.
* Exposure to a high-growth or ambiguous environment.
* Interest in finance operations, spend management, or B2B technology.

jobs.title: Assistant Project Manager
jobs.description:
Truebeck Construction is an industry-leading General Contractor serving Fortune 100 companies throughout the West Coast. Founded in the Bay Area, Truebeck has grown to five offices in California, Oregon and Washington. With annual revenue exceeding $1B, Truebeck is one of the top General Contractors in each of the markets we serve. Truebeck provides best-in-class services and builds award-winning projects in the commercial, healthcare, life science, mission critical, education, multi-family, and interiors sectors. Truebeck has developed an impressive portfolio of projects—for prominent companies like Apple, Bloomberg, Meta, Uber, Genentech, and Gilead—and has a long history of consistent growth and profitability.

Our Culture

At Truebeck, a core value is: business and life are all about people. In the office and on the job site, we put people first. Truebeck is consistently ranked as one of the Best Places to Work by local Business Journals, and year after year, we win Excellence in Safety Awards. Our culture is caring, and you’ll see this shine through in employee benefits and opportunities for growth and advancement. We also give back to our community in meaningful ways, and you’ll feel proud to work for a firm that has received the highest recognition as a Top Corporate Philanthropist.

Purpose

The Assistant Project Manager (APM) supports the Project Manager (PM) and/or Project Executive (PX) in managing preconstruction and construction activities, taking on increasing portions of schedule, budget, and client communications. Serves as a liaison role between the Senior Project Engineer (SPE) and PM. APMs are also responsible for providing service and executing decisions to the team at a level where mistakes will cause more exposure and risk to Truebeck. The APM will take the skills acquired from the SPE role and utilize those to manage significant scopes of work for large jobs and a full range of project engineer competencies on smaller jobs with more autonomy.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

**Project Management**

* Under the guidance of the Project Manager or Project Executive, manage day-to-day operations for assigned portions of the project or small projects.
* Lead coordination of selected subcontractors and suppliers.
* Support development of buy-out road maps and assist with subcontract administration.
* Assist in preparing and reviewing project deliverables prior to client submission.
* Support budget management and forecasting activities.
* Monitor construction progress and lead selected status meetings.
* Ensure project activities align with schedules and profitability forecasts.
* Responsible for working with the Project Superintendent in managing, updating, and implementing project schedule.
* Any other task or duty as assigned or required by the Project Manager or Project Executive.

**BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT**

PermitFlow is redefining how America builds. We’re an applied AI company serving the nation’s builders, tackling one of the largest information challenges in the economy: understanding *what can be built, where, and how*. Our AI agent workforce helps the fastest-growing construction companies navigate everything from permitting and licensing to inspections and project closeouts – accelerating housing, clean-energy, and infrastructure development across the country.

Despite being a $1.6T industry, construction still suffers from massive delays, wasted capital, and lost opportunity. PermitFlow has already delivered unprecedented speed, accuracy, and visibility to over $20B in development, helping contractors reduce compliance time, de-risk projects, and scale with confidence.

As the U.S. enters a new capex supercycle across data centers, factories, housing, and renewables, joining PermitFlow means building the AI infrastructure at the core of every construction project driving the next wave of reindustrialization.

We’ve raised over $90M, most recently completing our Series B, from top-tier investors including Accel, Kleiner Perkins, Initialized, Y Combinator, Felicis, and Altos Ventures, with backing from leaders at OpenAI, Google, Procore, ServiceTitan, Zillow, PlanGrid, and Uber.

**Our HQ is in New York City with a hybrid schedule (3 in-office days per week). We prefer NYC-based candidates or those open to relocation.**

**About the Role**
==================

We've built the foundation for events at PermitFlow. Now we need someone to own the outcome and turn events into a pillar of our GTM motion.

This role runs the full events portfolio: industry conferences, owned events, customer-specific gatherings, and field marketing, plus ongoing experimentation with new formats, venues, and audiences. You'll execute hands-on, with internal and external support, and tie every event back to pipeline and revenue goals. We're an experimentation-heavy culture. You'll be given room to ideate, experiment, measure, and repeat what works.

This is a manager-level individual contributor role. You already know how to set goals, manage a budget, and partner across teams, and you'll bring that experience on day one.

**What You'll Do**
==================

* Own the events portfolio: build the calendar across industry events, owned events, customer events, and field marketing, and decide where to place bets.
* Run logistics end to end: venues, budgets, vendors, contractors, staffing, and the on-the-ground run of show.
* Experiment deliberately and iterate quickly: test new formats, venues, and target audiences, and kill what doesn't work.
* Get the right targets in the room and at our booth. Great events don't stop at a project plan; they rely on driving high-value attendees.
* Connect events to revenue: define what success looks like for each event, track pipeline and revenue impact, and report results back to the business.
* Partner cross-functionally: work closely with demand gen, product marketing, sales, CS, and business operations to align events with GTM priorities.
* Manage event budgets and vendor relationships: negotiate contracts, manage contractor relationships, and keep spend accountable.
* Build the playbook: turn what's worked into repeatable processes so the program scales as the business grows.
* Represent events at the leadership level: bring recommendations and results directly to company leadership.
* Source speaking opportunities at relevant industry and public events for executive leadership, including content submissions as needed.

**Who You Are**
===============

* 4-7+ years running B2B events in a fast-moving environment and know the difference between an event that just looks good and one that drives pipeline.
* You can run logistics yourself. You don't need a coordinator to book a venue or manage a floor plan, but you know when and what to delegate.
* You think like a marketer first and an event planner second: every event ties back to organizational goals.
* You've worked closely with partners in Sales, Customer Success, and Executives.
* You're comfortable with ambiguity. This program is evolving, and you'll be instrumental in building the playbooks and processes.
* Bonus: experience in construction, home services, or a related built-world industry.
* Bonus: experience at a startup or in AI, and genuine interest in how physical infrastructure gets built.

**What We Offer**
=================

* Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a high-growth company
* 100% company-paid base medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees + healthcare FSA
* 401(k) savings plan
* Unlimited PTO and paid family leave
* Home office & equipment stipend
