Reporting to the Manager, Advancement Operations and Corporate Membership, the Coordinator, Advancement Operations supports all activities related to the Museum’s CRM (Tessitura), assists with the corporate membership program, provides administrative support to the Institutional Advancement department, and project manages specific work throughout the year. jobs.title: Enterprise Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Why Join Ivo?**
=================

Contracts are the oldest business technology in human history. They allow us to collaborate: they define what we promise each other, how we work together, and what happens when things go wrong.
  
  
Ivo builds AI products that helps companies like Meta, Uber, IBM, Intel, DoorDash, Mitsubishi Electric, and Coinbase solve their most difficult contracting problems. We think that large language models have created an opportunity to fundamentally change how businesses collaborate with each other.  
  
At Ivo you will work on challenging problems with colleagues who have high standards for each other, move fast, and care deeply about their craft.

**The Opportunity**
===================

Contracts shape how enterprises win customers, buy technology, work with partners, and manage risk. But reviewing them and finding the answers inside still takes too much expert time—slowing decisions across the business. Ivo is building AI that helps legal teams review and negotiate contracts, apply company standards, and turn agreements into actionable intelligence. Our ambition is bigger than making legal work faster: we’re building toward becoming the system of record for how enterprises work with contracts.

As Enterprise Account Manager, drive the growth of AI solutions within large enterprise clients. You’ll own renewals and expansion across major accounts, helping customers realize value and extend it across their businesses. You’ll build relationships beyond the original buyer, uncover opportunities with new teams, and grow adoption of Ivo’s expanding product portfolio—connecting each solution to a real business need. With customers like Meta, Uber, IBM and Intel, and ARR up sixfold in the last 12 months, there’s strong momentum and a playbook still to shape. You’ll help turn that opportunity into lasting, enterprise-wide partnerships.

**What You’ll Own**
-------------------

* **Take full ownership of Ivo’s largest customer relationships.** Develop and manage named accounts from prospecting to contracting across the business units. Own the commercial health, renewals, and expansion of your accounts, with the judgment and accountability to move them forward without waiting for a playbook. Build a clear view of each customer’s business, the value they’re realizing, and what stands between today’s relationship and a broader partnership. Turn that understanding into an account strategy with concrete priorities, owners, and next steps—and stay close enough to the details to make it happen.
* **Build relationships that create value across the organization.** Earn trust with day-to-day legal users, business leaders, executive sponsors, and budget owners, then extend those relationships into the teams whose work depends on contracts. Understand what each stakeholder is trying to achieve, where their priorities intersect, and where they differ. You’re not collecting contacts: you’re building a network of people who see a meaningful role for Ivo in their business and can work together to make it real.
* **Bring the right people into the conversation at the right time.** Understand how decisions actually get made: who champions change, who controls budget, who needs technical confidence, and who can block execution. Know when to deepen discovery, involve a Solutions Architect or Legal Engineer, equip a champion, or bring executives together around a strategic decision. Give every participant the context and preparation to contribute, anticipate approval requirements, and resolve dependencies before they become last-minute obstacles.
* **Be deeply analytical about where value is—and where it could be.** Partner with CSMs, who lead adoption, to connect usage patterns and customer outcomes with the account’s business priorities. Look beyond headline metrics to understand which teams are benefiting, where workflows still break down, and why promising use cases have not gained traction. Test your assumptions with customers, quantify opportunities where the evidence supports it, and distinguish genuine readiness to expand from interest that has no clear owner, budget, or business case.
* **Turn customer outcomes into a compelling case for investment.** Translate what Ivo helps customers achieve into business terms: less time spent reviewing agreements or finding answers, faster decisions, more consistent standards, and better visibility into contractual commitments and risk. Build credible business cases with clear baselines, explicit assumptions, and outcomes customers can measure. Help champions make the case internally, and lead thoughtful executive conversations about what matters, what needs to change, and why the next investment is worthwhile.
* **Help customers build toward Ivo as their system of record for contracts.** Develop a long-term vision with customers for how Ivo can become central to the way their organization works with contracts—not simply another tool used by one team. Connect that ambition to current capabilities and a practical sequence of use cases across Ivo’s expanding product portfolio. Help customers identify the stakeholders, workflow changes, and internal commitments needed to progress, so better access to contract knowledge positions their teams to move quickly and execute business decisions with confidence.
* **Run disciplined renewal and expansion cycles.** Translate account strategy into opportunities with a clear customer problem, a path to value, stakeholder alignment, and a realistic decision process. Own the commercial cycle through procurement, legal review, negotiation, and close. Surface risk early, maintain an evidence-based forecast, and build shared plans that make the next decision and its dependencies clear. Balance urgency with thoughtfulness: move quickly without skipping the work that makes a commitment durable.
* **Lead across Ivo and turn insight into action.** Bring CSMs, Solutions Architects, Product, Finance, and Legal Engine

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

North America Seller Business (NASB) Finance Team is seeking a Finance Manager to serve as the strategic finance partner for Strategic Account Services (SAS) and New Seller Recruitment (NSR) businesses. In this role, you will own end-to-end P&L management, deliver financial insights that drive business decisions, and partner closely with senior business leaders to optimize performance and accelerate growth. You will play a critical role in shaping the financial strategy for programs that directly impact Amazon's third-party seller ecosystem, from recruiting new sellers to scaling the success of established ones.  
  
The ideal candidate is a self-starter who thrives in ambiguity, can translate complex financial data into actionable narratives, and is passionate about influencing business outcomes through financial partnership.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Own end-to-end P&L management for SAS and NSR, including forecasting, variance analysis, and financial reporting,
* Serve as the primary finance partner to SAS and NSR business leaders (Directors), providing strategic guidance on P&L management, investment decisions, headcount planning, and resource allocation,
* Lead Monthly Financial Reviews (MFRs) and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), delivering clear visibility into performance drivers and key input metrics (selection, pricing, inventory...),
* Develop and maintain financial models to evaluate business proposals, program ROI, and scenario analyses,
* Identify and communicate risks and opportunities through deep-dive analysis, and recommend actionable mitigation strategies,
* Partner cross-functionally with New Seller Recruitment Team, Strategic Account Services Team , Business Intelligence teams to ensure data accuracy and alignment on planning assumptions,
* Support goal-setting frameworks and reporting processes,
* Develop and automate reporting mechanisms to improve efficiency and scalability of financial processes,
* Champion AI-driven innovation by designing and deploying AI agents and knowledge bases for SAS and NSR that scale business operations and automate workflows,
* Influence business strategy by providing data-driven insights on seller economics, fee structures, and program effectiveness.

  
A day in the life  
Your morning might start with reviewing the latest seller performance and identifying trends in SAS seller attribution or NSR recruitment metrics. By mid-morning, you're in a working session with the NSR program lead, aligning on goal-setting assumptions and refining the financial model for an upcoming business review.  
  
After lunch, you join a cross-functional meeting with the SAS program team to walk through variance drivers from the latest MFR, explaining how seller enrollments, headcount changes, or program investments are impacting the P&L. You provide clear, concise narratives that help leadership understand the "so what" behind the numbers.  
  
Later in the afternoon, you're building a scenario analysis for a new seller incentive proposal, stress-testing assumptions and quantifying the expected ROI. Before wrapping up, you connect with your finance peers to align on planning inputs for the upcoming OP2 cycle.  
  
No two days are exactly alike, but every day involves a blend of analytical deep-dives, strategic partnership, and storytelling through data.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of applying key financial performance indicators (KPIs) to analyses experience
* 5+ years of building financial and operational reports/data sets that inform business decision-making experience
* 5+ years of participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards)

**MAIN JOB OBJECTIVE**

We are seeking an exceptional senior Executive Assistant to provide high-level administrative and operational support to more than one C-Suite/Leadership Executives. This role requires a highly proactive, polished, and trusted partner who consistently thinks ahead, anticipates executive needs, identifies potential problems before they arise, and takes initiative to resolve them. The ideal candidate has proven experience supporting more than one executive simultaneously and is a strong multitasker who can connect dots across priorities, manage complex workflows and competing demands, and adapt quickly without compromising accuracy or follow-through. Resourceful and creative, this individual thinks beyond established approaches, offers practical solutions, and identifies opportunities to streamline processes and help create leverage for senior leaders in a fast-paced global environment. Success requires sound judgment, strong business acumen, excellent communication skills, meticulous attention to detail, and the ability to build effective relationships, remain composed under pressure, and distinguish when to act independently versus escalate. Above all, we are looking for someone who operates with discretion, urgency, and ownership, follows commitments through to completion, and serves as a dependable partner while remaining in an Executive Assistant capacity.

 **Job Description**

**JOB RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Manage complex and ever-changing day-to-day schedules for multiple executives via Microsoft Outlook, including prioritizing requests, resolving conflicts, and coordinating meetings across multiple time zones.
* Serve as a trusted administrative partner who anticipates executive needs, identifies issues before they arise, and operates with a consistent one-step-ahead mentality.
* Act as a central point of coordination across priorities, meetings, travel, communications, and follow-ups to ensure executives are prepared, aligned, and able to focus on the highest-impact work.
* Prepare executives for meetings and appointments by developing agendas, gathering materials, coordinating logistics, preparing conference rooms and audio/visual needs, and ensuring timely follow-through on next steps.
* Draft, edit, and organize executive communications, presentations, meeting notes, briefings, and other materials with clarity, accuracy, and strong attention to audience and tone.

* Handle confidential and sensitive information with impeccable discretion, sound judgment, and professionalism; know when to escalate, redirect, or protect information appropriately.
* Act as a liaison between executives and internal/external stakeholders, representing leaders with polish, responsiveness, and a strong service mindset.
* Support special projects and operational initiatives as assigned, helping to organize workstreams, track deliverables, and drive timely follow-through.
* Support the planning and execution of company-wide events, leadership meetings, team gatherings, offsites, and employee engagement moments, including coordinating timelines, logistics, communications, vendors, materials, and follow-up actions
* Assist with office management and workplace operations, including maintaining an organized, welcoming office environment; coordinating supplies, space needs, visitor logistics, facilities requests, and vendor support; and helping ensure day-to-day office needs are handled proactively and professionally.

What you will learn in the first 6 months:

* Learn each executive's working style, communication preferences, business priorities, key stakeholders, and expectations for meeting preparation, scheduling, travel, and follow-through.
* Become highly proficient in Microsoft Outlook for advanced calendar management, and master expense systems like Medius and Concur.
* Integrate into the company culture, learning the organizational structure, key internal and external contacts, and relevant company policies.
* Begin to demonstrate a proactive, business-minded, "one-step-ahead" approach by anticipating needs, identifying potential roadblocks, and offering thoughtful solutions.

What you will achieve in 12 months:

* Provide strategic calendar and operational support that enables executives to focus on key priorities, including long-range planning, project coordination, and effective meeting flow.
* Confidently draft and refine memos, presentations, meeting materials, and executive briefing

* Qualified leads and referrals.
* Appointments scheduled and completed.

Please submit your resume through Indeed.

**About Agentio**
-----------------

Agentio enables marketers to buy creator-led ads as easily and scalably as Meta or Google ads—automating sourcing, pricing, contracting, delivery, and measurement—so work that took months now happens in minutes.

We’re on a mission to transform a $800B digital ad ecosystem by shifting digital ad spend into the hands of creators. That means better outcomes for marketers and enabling creators to live off their work—finally being paid in proportion to the value they create. That shift is accelerating: Unilever’s CEO has said the company will move roughly half of its ad budget into social and creators—Unilever is among the world’s largest advertisers, spending around $9–10B annually. As these dollars move, they need performance-grade pipes; Agentio is how those dollars flow to creators with the speed, control, and measurement marketers expect. We enable brands like Uber, DoorDash, and Bombas to run creator campaigns with the same rigor, control, and accountability as their core performance channels.

Our AI-Native platform enables real-time content understanding at scale, simultaneous reasoning across hundreds of thousands of pieces of content, and intelligent allocation of multi-million dollar budgets. Our models apply more cross-platform performance signal than anyone else in the world, compounding with every campaign through a high-trust marketplace with accelerating network effects. The result is a flywheel: brands get the performance they’ve been chasing, creators get the intelligence and income they deserve, and Agentio becomes the infrastructure powering a generational shift in where media dollars flow.

The market agrees. Agentio has raised $56M at a $340M valuation, including a Series B led by Forerunner that followed our Series A within a calendar year. Backed by Benchmark, Craft, and AlleyCorp. Named to Forbes’ Next Billion Dollar Startups, 2025. Named to Inc.’s Best Places to Work 2026, one of 10 companies nationally recognized in the “On the Rise: 0–4 Years in Business” category.

An $800B market. A once-in-a-generation technology shift. This is the moment. This is the team. Come build something generational with us.

**About the Role**

You’ll start out reporting directly to our CEO, working alongside our sales leaders, with broader scope as the team grows. This is a rare chance to learn how the best people in a fast-growing company think about winning deals, with a clear path into a seller or broader GTM role.

Our CEO and sales leaders are out in the market constantly: at conferences, on customer and investor trips, in rooms full of potential clients we want to meet with. The relationships they start there are some of the best pipeline we have. But leaders get busy, and we need to build a more systematic way of providing leverage to our CEO and GTM leadership.

This is different from a traditional SDR seat. You aren’t working a queue of leads. Your work follows our leaders: where they’re going, who they met, and what’s next. That means the work is less structured, moves faster, and needs real judgment. You’ll write in their voice, manage their threads, and represent them to senior buyers.

You’ll work directly with our CEO and GTM leaders, report into a sales leader, and eventually partner with our SDR Manager as the team grows. It’s a rare chance to learn how the best people in a fast-growing company think about winning deals, with a clear path into a seller or broader GTM role.

**What You’ll Do**

* Take over the outbound inboxes and LinkedIn profiles of our CEO and sales leaders, and run outreach on their behalf in their voice

**Overview:**

**2020 Companies is now hiring a full-time Break-Fix Coordinator!**

The Break-Fix Coordinator is responsible for the day-to-day coordination, tracking, and follow-through of break-fix and revisit requests across assigned retail programs. This role manages the operational workflow from request intake through field assignment, visit creation, execution follow-up, documentation, and closeout preparation, ensuring requests move forward accurately and within defined service expectations.

The Break-Fix Coordinator partners closely with the Break-Fix Manager, Scheduling, Field Leadership, FROST/Audit, SMEs, Account Management, and field representatives. Coordinators maintain accurate case information and provide the Break-Fix Manager with the details, status, documentation, and risks needed for client communication and program reporting.

jobs.title: Territory Account Manager - ATLANTA
jobs.description:
ViiV Healthcare is a global specialty HIV company, the only one that is 100% focused on researching and delivering new medicines for people living with, and at risk of, HIV. ViiV Healthcare is highly mission-driven in our unrelenting commitment to being a trusted partner for all people living with and affected by HIV. Our aim is to think, act, and connect differently through a focus on education on for the prevention and treatment for HIV. We go to extraordinary lengths to deliver the sorts of breakthroughs, both in prevention, treatments, care solutions and communities, that really count. We go beyond the boundaries of medicine by taking a holistic approach to HIV through developing and supporting sustainable community programs and improving access to care. We are fully committed to push through every challenge until HIV/AIDS is eradicated. ViiV Healthcare has played a significant part in delivering breakthroughs that have turned HIV into a manageable health condition. We offer the largest portfolio of HIV medicines available anywhere, and we continue our work to cater for the widest possible range of needs in response to the HIV epidemic.

We are aware of how much is at stake for those at-risk or affected by HIV and we show up every day 100% committed to the patients. Our work culture is fast-paced, diverse, inclusive, competitive, and caring. But ViiV Healthcare isn’t just somewhere to work – it’s a place to belong, an invitation to bring your very best, and a team full of impact-driven team members who are hungry to make a difference.

While we have been improving lives of HIV patients for 30 years, this is an especially exciting time to be at ViiV Healthcare, as we evaluate novel approaches to treatment and prevention that could further reduce the impact of HIV on individuals and communities.

ViiV Healthcare is seeking an experienced, results-driven professional in Specialty Sales for the position of **Territory Account Manager (TAM)** on the long-acting HIV Injectable Treatment Sales team. The ability to thrive in a fast-paced, complex environment and work with HCPs to adopt a new approach to HIV treatment will be essential to delivering success in this role. Additionally, the abilities to partner cross-functionally and to remain highly adaptable in a launch context will be critical. It is expected that the successful candidate will have demonstrated experience in developing strategic business plans with specific, measurable, action-oriented objectives in accordance with territory and account level goals. Successful outcomes will include selling to HCPs, servicing their accounts, and being aligned to ViiV Healthcare’s mission of leaving no person with HIV behind. This will be achieved through driving results against business objectives and working effectively within an integrated account management framework in the setup and delivery of a buy and bill treatment model.

This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career, these responsibilities include some of the following:

* Deliver Results Through Exceptional Sales and Service
* Identify, target, and win new business by influencing working with HCPs to adopt a new approach to HIV treatment
* Engage with HCPs, nurses, staff, and administrators to accurately understand the clinical, organizational, and financial challenges and opportunities within target accounts
* Leverage data analytics, business acumen, and market expertise to identify high-priority prospects
* Prepare and execute business plans that are tailored to the unique needs of each customer and that help HCPs scale their treatment model to reach more patients
* Coordinate, engage, and partner with multiple cross-functional team members (i.e., Clinical Nurse Educators and Field Reimbursement Managers) to deliver an integrated product experience to customers

jobs.title: Executive Assistant, CEO
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**
--------------

Pindrop is a cybersecurity company delivering continuous identity verification across voice, video, and digital interactions. Powered by the Pindrop Intelligence Network, our unified trust platform helps enterprises answer three critical questions:

**Is this identity synthetic?** Detect AI-generated and manipulated voice and video.  
**Is this identity risky?** Identify fraud, suspicious behavior, and other risk signals.  
**Is this identity known?** Authenticate identities using voice, device, behavioral, and other signals.

Pindrop brings this intelligence together across purpose-built trust engines to help organizations make informed decisions in real time — protecting customers, workforce interactions, and emerging AI-driven interactions.

Pindrop protects billions of high-risk interactions for enterprises, including leading financial institutions, insurers, and healthcare organizations. Its technology is informed by more than 8 billion real-world interactions annually and protected by 300+ patents.

Recognized by TIME as one of the 10 Most Influential Software Companies of 2026 and by Inc. for Best in Business for Innovation, Pindrop is backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz, IVP, and CapitalG.

**What you'll do**
------------------

We're hiring an Executive Assistant to support our CEO as a trusted partner and operational extension. This role is for a seasoned, self-directed professional who operates with sound judgment and executive presence, and who moves work forward without needing to be asked. You'll manage time, priorities, and communication so the CEO and leadership team can stay focused on what drives the most impact. The best partners in this role know what's needed before it's requested, make confident decisions within their remit, and keep the CEO's attention for the things that truly require it.

Time and prioritization

* Own the CEO's calendar with a clear understanding of business priorities, and make scheduling decisions independently rather than routing routine choices back for approval.
* Protect focus time as a non-negotiable. When time is blocked, it stays blocked, and it is never converted into meetings without explicit direction.
* Keep meeting load sustainable by challenging low-value requests, consolidating where possible, and maintaining a realistic daily rhythm that preserves energy and thinking time.
* Design a lean, purposeful cadence of recurring touchpoints. Default to concise written updates over standing meetings, and reserve live time for topics that need the CEO's voice.

Judgment and decision-making

* Operate with delegated authority. When the CEO says to go ahead, you decide, act, and inform afterward.
* Bring recommendations instead of open questions. When input is truly needed, present a clear point of view, the options considered, and the tradeoffs, so the CEO can approve in seconds.
* Know the CEO's preferences, standards, and priorities well enough to make the call he would make.

Scheduling, travel, and logistics

* Coordinate complex domestic and international travel, agendas, and briefings end to end, with details resolved before they become questions.
* Anticipate changes, resolve issues quickly and quietly, and ensure smooth transitions between engagements.

Preparation and follow-through

* Work closely with Sales partners to build account strategies and create opportunities within priority banking, financial services and insurance accounts.

* Collaborate daily with Field Marketing on the campaigns, MQLs, events and target accounts that matter most.
* Be accountable for a monthly opportunity-creation target and quarterly MBOs, with a focus on quality, progression and pipeline impact.

**This is your Team**

Working within the global demand generation team, you will be tightly aligned with Field Marketing, Sales and other regional partners to build and qualify BFSI demand. Your team will include 15+ BDR and SDR colleagues located across the globe, bringing varied market perspectives and experience levels, from graduates to seasoned professionals.

**Who we are looking for**

Are you someone who thrives on targets and individual achievement, while contributing to a creative, collaborative team? Are you curious about financial services and motivated to understand the challenges faced by banks, insurers and other regulated enterprises?

**Moreover, we are looking for:**

  

* 3+ years of experience as a Sales Development Representative, Business Development Representative or in a similar customer-facing role.
* Experience engaging enterprise accounts, ideally within banking, financial services, insurance, fintech or another regulated industry.
* Confidence researching complex organizations, mapping stakeholders and turning business challenges into relevant outreach.
* A highly motivated, commercially curious and creative mindset, with the drive to learn and grow.

* We care about our colleague’s work-life balance, and we offer flexibility through a hybrid work model.
* International: A growing global company, worldwide career opportunities, and multicultural teams.
* Well-being: A caring and inspiring environment, promoting a happy and healthy lifestyle through a wide range of facilities and activities.

**This is who we are**

Stibo Systems is a global company with a Nordic heritage. We help companies transform into digital leaders through market-leading multidomain master data management that delivers transparency. Through our solution, large brands (our customers) connect data across their products, customers, stores, employees, suppliers, digital assets and much, much more.

**Assistant Project Manager - HVAC**

**Position Overview**

As an Assistant Project Manager - HVAC, you'll support the successful execution of commercial HVAC and integrated mechanical projects by assisting the Project Manager in coordinating activities, ensuring alignment with scope, schedule, budget, and quality standards, while focusing on HVAC system design, installation, and performance. This role contributes to delivering high-performance, sustainable mechanical outcomes for clients in commercial and critical environments across any of our operating companies. Our people-first culture empowers your technical and organizational skills with professional growth opportunities, mentorship, cross-functional collaboration, and the satisfaction of helping deliver reliable, efficient building systems nationwide.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

* Assist the Project Manager in planning, coordinating, and overseeing HVAC-related projects, including heating, ventilation, air conditioning systems, ductwork, piping, and integration with building infrastructure.
* Support development and maintenance of project schedules, milestones, and resource allocation using industry-standard tools.
* Track project costs, prepare cost projections, monitor budgets, and assist in identifying and managing variances, change orders, or value engineering opportunities.
* Coordinate with internal teams (field technicians, engineers, installers, subcontractors), vendors, and clients to ensure timely procurement, submittals, approvals, fabrication, and installation of HVAC equipment and components.

* Help manage documentation, including contracts, RFIs, change requests, submittals, as-built drawings, and project close-out packages.
* Support risk identification and mitigation efforts related to HVAC scope, equipment performance, technical integration, and project delivery.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

None (this role has no direct supervisory responsibilities but requires close collaboration with project managers, field teams, and other departments; may involve guiding or mentoring junior staff or interns as needed).

**Requirements/Qualifications**

* **Experience**: 2+ years of experience in project coordination, assistant project management, or field/operations roles within HVAC, mechanical contracting, construction, or related industries. Recent graduates with engineering or construction management degrees who have relevant experience or strong interest in commercial HVAC are encouraged to apply.
* **Education**: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* **Certifications/Licenses**: Valid driver's license and clean driving record required; OSHA 10/30-hour certification encouraged (company support provided).

This is a safety-sensitive position.

**Required Skills**

* Familiarity with commercial HVAC systems (chillers, boilers, air handlers, VAV systems, rooftop units, piping/ductwork) and integration with other building systems preferred.
* Understanding of project management principles, including scheduling, cost control, procurement, and risk management.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Project, Word); experience with project management software (Procore, Autodesk BIM 360, Bluebeam, or similar) is a plus.
* Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills with keen attention to detail.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities to collaborate across multidisciplinary teams, subcontractors, and clients.
* Ability to travel to project sites as required and work in a fast-paced, field-oriented environment.

Modigent is a national leader delivering next-generation infrastructure, technology, and energy solutions through our family of specialized brands in HVAC, plumbing, and controls systems. With a strong coast-to-coast presence and extensive service capabilities, we empower customers, communities, and our over 1,500 team members to thrive with sustainable, efficient commercial building services. As part of our team, you'll contribute to thoughtful innovation and our people-first culture rooted in service, collaboration, and integrity.

**Why Work at Modigent**

jobs.title: Executive Assistant Part-Time
jobs.description:
Replies within 24 hours

Executive Assistant(Part-Time, Morning On Site)

**D1 Training Sandy Springs**

**Commitment:** 2 hours/day, in-person, weekday mornings — exact window set within **6:00– 10:00 AM** based on the right candidate's availability

**Pay:** $15–$20/hour, based on experience

**Reports to:** Owner, directly

The Role

I co-own D1 Training Sandy Springs and oversee it remotely. This role exists to close that gap — someone on-site each morning who keeps me organized, informed, and on top of what's actually happening at the gym, and who takes real ownership of operational and administrative work as they get familiar with how we run things.

This is a growth role, not a fixed job description. You'll start with the basics and take on more — payroll, process improvements, scheduling — as you learn our systems and earn trust.

It's a strong fit for:

A stay-at-home parent with a predictable morning window

A retired professional who wants a light, purposeful routine

A student whose morning window lands early enough (e.g., 6–8 AM) to wrap up before school starts

What You'll Actually Do

**Keep me looped in** — a quick daily rundown of what's happening at the gym and what needs my attention

**Own the operational to-do list** — track what's outstanding, follow up with the team, make sure things don't slip

**Support payroll** — start with the basics (verifying hours, prepping what I need to review), grow into more as you learn our systems

**Help manage scheduling** — staff shifts, the class calendar, or my own commitments tied to the gym, depending on where the gap is

**Keep me organized** — notes, files, tracking commitments, the general administrative backbone

**Flag process improvements** — once you know how things actually run, tell me what's inefficient or could be better

What This Isn't

Not coaching, not member-facing sales, not floor management — that stays with our GM and coaching team. This role is the organizational and administrative side working directly for me, not a second layer of gym leadership.

WhatWe're Looking For

Reliable — the same 2 hours, most mornings, is what makes this work

Comfortable with responsibility and some ambiguity — this role grows, and you'll be trusted with more as you prove you can handle it

Discreet — you'll have visibility into payroll and other sensitive information; that stays confidential

Organized, and honest when something's not getting done

No prior gym or ops experience required — we'll train you on our systems

How to Apply

Reach out to any of us:

**Chad Gazzola (Co-Owner):** 770-374-7125 or chad.gazzola@d1training.com **Jessica Kent (Co-Owner):** 770-374-6153 or jessica.kent@d1sandysprings.com **TylerAdams (General Manager):** 770-713-4301 or tyler.adams@d1sandysprings.com

  
  
  

D1 Training is an emerging fitness franchise, that is growing rapidly. D1 Training has over 80 facilities open and 180+ in development. No gimmicks, no fads; we utilize trusted and proven training techniques used to build the world’s best athletes and deliver the, in age-appropriate programs led by our expert coaches. What began as training solely for the aspiring youth athlete, matured into fitness training for adults as well. Studio & Fulfillment Assistant | Part-Time

**Render Goods | Chicago, IL | $22/hour**

**Monday–Friday | Starting 20 Hours per Week | Flexible Scheduling**

About the Role:

Render Goods is looking for a reliable, organized, and hands-on person to help with the day-to-day operations of our Chicago housewares studio.

This is a part-time, in-person position working directly alongside me, the founder, to keep orders moving, products looking their best, and daily studio operations running smoothly.

The role is a mix of order fulfillment, light product production, inventory organization, and general logistical support. Some days will involve packing and shipping orders, while others might include preparing products for retail, assembling packaging, running production machines, organizing inventory, or general studio upkeep.

We're a small, growing business, so no two days are exactly alike! I'm looking for someone who enjoys working with their hands, has a good eye for detail, and is comfortable jumping between different tasks as needed.

**While we're initially hiring for a general studio assistant, we're hoping to find someone who can grow with us.** Render is entering an exciting new chapter of growth, and we'd love to find a long-term team member whose interests, experience, and individual strengths could eventually contribute to the business in a more meaningful way.

If you have additional skills in e-commerce, Shopify, graphic design, photography, email marketing, or creative production, we'd love to hear about them! These skills aren't required for the initial position, but we're interested in learning what else you could bring to the table as the role evolves.

About Render Goods

Render Goods is a woman-owned, Chicago-based housewares studio creating thoughtfully designed everyday essentials from recycled, biodegradable, and otherwise responsibly sourced materials.

Our collection includes colorful dish towels made from recycled plastic bottles, Swedish dishcloths, washcloths, and natural-fiber cleaning brushes. We sell through independent retailers, online, and at markets and events throughout the country.

Our Chicago studio serves as the home base for product development, light manufacturing, inventory, and fulfillment.

Schedule & Location

**Chicago, IL | West Town / Near West Side**

* Monday through Friday, approximately 20 hours per week.
* Flexible daytime scheduling to accommodate school, other work, or personal commitments.
* Consistent weekly availability is preferred, but exact hours can be arranged together.
* Some overlapping work hours are required, but independent working time in the studio is available to the right person
* Optional opportunities for additional weekend hours at markets and events (pending you have a car).
* Occasional opportunities to assist with larger Chicago events, including the One of a Kind Show, providing on-site setup, merchandising, and logistical support.

This is primarily a studio-based position, not a retail sales role.

Responsibilities

**Shipping & Order Fulfillment**

* Pick, pack, and prepare online and wholesale orders for shipment.
* Ensure orders are accurate, neatly packaged, and shipped on time.
* Print shipping labels, prepare cartons, and organize outgoing packages.
* Help maintain shipping supplies and packaging materials.
* Assist with larger wholesale orders and seasonal shipping volume.

**Product Finishing & Light Production**

* Assemble product packaging, labels, tags, and retail-ready materials.
* Inspect finished products for quality and presentation.
* Fold, bundle, package, and prepare products for retail and wholesale distribution.
* Assist with simple production and finishing tasks as needed.
* Help maintain consistency and quality across finished products.

**Studio Organization & Logistics**

* Receive deliveries, unpack shipments, and organize incoming inventory.
* Restock supplies and maintain an organized workspace.
* Prepare inventory and materials for markets, wholesale accounts, and special events.
* Assist with inventory counts and general stock organization.
* Help with miscellaneous studio projects and daily operational tasks.

**Events & Special Projects**

* Help prepare displays, merchandise, and supplies for upcoming events.
* Occasionally provide on-site assistance at larger Chicago markets and trade shows.
* Assist with new product development, samples, and creative projects as opportunities arise.

Requirements

* Reliable, punctual, organized, and detail-oriented.
* Comfortable working independently and following instructions.
* Good time management skills and ability to prioritize tasks.
* Strong attention to detail, particularly with packaging and order accuracy.
* Comfortable performing repetitive, hands-on tasks.
* Ability to lift and carry up to 40 lbs.
* Willingness to learn new processes and take initiative.
* Comfortable working directly with the founder in a small studio environment.
* Previous shipping, fulfillment, retail, or production experience is a plus, but not required.

Bonus Skills & Opportunities for Growth

No specialized experience is required beyond a willingness to learn, but we're especially interested in candidates who bring additional skills, creative interests, or experience that could help us grow.

Some areas we'd love to hear about include:

* **E-commerce & Shopify:** Online store management, product listings, merchandising, or order management.

* **Graphic Design:** Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, packaging design, or print production.
* **Light Manufacturing:** CO2 laser engraving, screen printing, production equipment, or hands-on fabrication.

CPAF’s multi-lingual and multi-cultural services include a 24-hour hotline, short term and long-term shelters, counseling, case management, and supportive services. CPAF also provides violence prevention programs, outreach, education and advocacy on the issues of family violence and violence against women, focusing on the Asian and Pacific Islander community.

===============

Wellness Equity Alliance is a national multidisciplinary health organization that designs and delivers integrated, community-based care for populations most impacted by health inequities. We do this through mobile and field-based models, providing medical care, behavioral health services, substance use treatment, harm reduction, and care coordination in nontraditional settings such as encampments, schools, reentry sites, and rural communities, as well as with sovereign tribal nations. Grounded in trauma-informed, culturally responsive, and data-driven practices, WEA combines clinical expertise, lived experience, and advanced population health analytics to reduce barriers to care, improve continuity, and strengthen local systems. We have partnered with more than 60 public agencies, managed care plans, and community-based organizations across the U.S. to implement scalable, sustainable programs that are advancing health equity and improving outcomes for historically marginalized populations.

We are known as Renegades, Rebels, Disruptors, and Dreamers. If that sounds like you, we want you on our team.

7Leaves Café isn't just a coffee and tea shop, it's a gathering place built on connection, culture, and craft. Since opening our first store in 2011, a small dream shared by siblings and friends has grown into more than 40 locations across the Southwest. Our mission has always stayed the same: to enrich the human experience through thoughtfully crafted beverages and a warm, welcoming environment.

We're entering one of the most exciting chapters in our journey, expanding into new regions, elevating our customer experience, and continuing to serve an ever-growing community of loyal customers.

As we continue to grow, our Support Office plays an essential role in strengthening our operations, supporting our teams, and shaping the future of 7Leaves.

**About the Role**
------------------

The Store Design & Development Coordinator supports the Store Design and Store Development teams through project coordination, field visits, documentation, sourcing, and administrative support. This role gathers accurate field information, coordinates furniture and material needs, and follows up on outstanding items to help keep store projects and improvement initiatives moving forward.

This is a support and coordination position. Advanced architectural or design software experience is not required. Familiarity with Revit, AutoCAD, Bluebeam, or similar programs is a plus.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* Comprehensive Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision plans available for eligible employees.
* Professional Growth: Opportunities to expand your skills, develop professionally, and grow alongside our organization.
* Meaningful Impact: Play an important role in supporting our teams, strengthening our operations, and contributing to the future of 7Leaves.
* Collaborative Culture: Be part of a supportive environment that values authenticity, teamwork, and continuous growth.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

Store Design Support

* Visit existing and future store locations to take measurements, photographs, and notes documenting existing conditions.
* Document design-related issues observed during store visits and share findings with the appropriate team members.
* Organize plans, specifications, material selections, and other design documentation.
* Support furniture, fixture, and equipment coordination, and track design requests and store improvement items.
* Coordinate information among Store Design, Store Development, Operations, vendors, contractors, consultants, and other stakeholders.

Materials and Furniture Coordination

* Research and source finish materials, furniture, fixtures, decor, and other store design items.
* Request product information, samples, pricing, availability, and lead times from vendors.
* Maintain an organized library of material samples, vendor information, and product specifications.

* Identify suitable replacement products or alternatives when existing materials or furniture are discontinued or unavailable for the team's review.

Store Visits and Design Audits

* Conduct periodic store visits to assess and document the condition of furniture, finishes, fixtures, signage, and other design elements.
* Photograph areas that may require repair, replacement, or design improvement.

* Verify measurements and existing conditions when additional field information is needed.
* Follow up on completed improvements and report whether the work aligns with the intended design.
* Identify opportunities to maintain a consistent store appearance and experience across locations.

Store Development Support

* Provide coordination and administrative support to the Store Development team.
* Maintain organized project records, schedules, vendor information, and documentation.
* Follow up with vendors, contractors, consultants, and internal teams on outstanding information, action items, and deadlines.
* Update project trackers and communicate progress or potential delays to the appropriate team members.
* Support special projects and field assignments related to store development and improvements.

**What You Bring**
------------------

Required Qualifications

* Strong organizational skills and professional written and verbal communication.
* Attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple assignments, deadlines, and follow-ups.
* Comfortable visiting active stores and construction sites and performing field assignments.
* Ability to take accurate measurements and document existing conditions, or willingness to learn.
* Ability to communicate effectively with vendors, contractors, store teams, and internal departments.
* Interest in store design, construction, architecture, interiors, retail development, or project coordination.
* Ability to work independently and coordinate priorities with the appropriate team leads.

Preferred Qualifications

* Previous experience in retail, hospitality, construction, architecture, interior design, facilities, or project coordination.

**About Got Kubek**

GOTKUBEK makes colorful reusable cups for coffee, smoothies, iced drinks and everything in between. We come in various colors, focusing sales through independent coffee shops across Los Angeles and Amazon, and offer custom logo printing for cafés and businesses. We’re a small, fast-moving team, and we run our own events, like our Halloween Coffee Hunt with local cafés in Silver Lake.

**The role**

We’re looking for a hands-on content creator who shoots, edits, posts, & strategizes brand content, with implementation of brand goals & guidelines across our marketing channels. You’ll utilize our Instagram and TikTok channels, speaking to two audiences at once: everyday people who use our cups every day, and the café owners who will sell them. Your job is to show the cup's practicality in as many real life scenarios as possible for the end user, and to drive interest toward new café owners to carry it.

**What you’ll do**

* Shoot and edit at least 12 Reels and 8 carousels per month, plus Instagram Stories every day
* Adapt the same videos for TikTok
* Create content that shows the cup & its contents in numerous settings: ex. coffee shops/coffee, teas, smoothies, the gym, the car, the office, festivals, the beach, hikes
* Create B2B content for café owners: how the cup can make them money, custom logo printing on the cups, in-store displays, interviews with partner cafés
* Visit partner cafés to film, and coordinate Instagram Collab posts with them
* Film and cover our events in real time, from start to finish
* Reply to comments and DMs every day, and pass wholesale inquiries to our sales team the same day
* Shoot photos and short videos for our Amazon listings
* Find and reach out to local creators and influencers for partnerships
* Send a content calendar every Monday for the week ahead
* Send a short monthly report covering reach, sends, saves, watch time and wholesale inquiries

**What we’re looking for**

* 2+ years creating content for a brand, a business or your own account
* A portfolio of Reels or TikToks **you personally shot and edited**
* Strong phone filming and editing skills (CapCut, Premiere, or similar)
* A good understanding of how Instagram works in 2026: Reels, carousels, Collab posts, hooks in the first 3 seconds, captions written for search
* Ability to collaborate with team to achieve brand goals.
* Comfortable on camera and approaching café owners and strangers
* Organized and self-driven. You post consistently without being reminded.
* A valid driver’s license and a reliable car (you’ll be driving to cafés around LA)

**What we offer**

* A monthly performance bonus of up to $[300–600] for hitting content volume and wholesale lead goals

**How to apply**

Apply on Indeed and include **links to Reels or TikToks you shot and edited yourself**, with one sentence on each about what you did. Applications without links won’t be considered.

new_jobs.title: Event Marketing Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About Bobyard**
-----------------

Construction is a multi-trillion-dollar industry that still estimates by hand. Contractors measure and count materials off drawings manually, and it caps how many jobs they can bid. Bobyard uses computer vision and NLP to automate takeoffs and estimates, so contractors bid faster and win more. We raised a $35M Series A led by 8VC, with Primary and Pear, and we're growing fast.

**About the role**

Contractors buy from people they've met, and a lot of those meetings happen on a trade show floor. You'll own Bobyard's events program across the trades we serve: landscaping, electrical, mechanical, concrete, and more. You'll set our events strategy, decide which events are worth it, run the biggest ones yourself, and report what each one returned in meetings and pipeline. You'll partner closely with sales, and plans will change often. The work is physical and show weeks are long. The payoff is knowing exactly which events win us customers.

**What you'll do**

* Set the events strategy and annual calendar, tier every event, and set a meetings target for each one before we sign
* Own the event budget and negotiate sponsorships, booth space, and vendor contracts
* Run booth logistics end to end: exhibitor deadlines, shipping, booth build, staffing, and on-site execution
* Work with our SDRs and AEs to book meetings before every show and staff the booth with the right people
* Get every lead into HubSpot and in front of the right rep within 48 hours of the show closing
* Report what each event cost and returned to leadership, and decide which events to drop, keep, or expand
* Write the playbook so each show runs faster than the last

**What we're looking for**

* 4+ years in event marketing or field marketing at a B2B company, including owning an events strategy and budget
* You've run 12 or more events a quarter, from major booths to walk-the-floor shows, contract to follow-up
* You've managed an event budget and can tell us the cost per meeting for shows you ran
* You work well with sales, including when they push back on your plan
* Strong vendor management and contract negotiation
* Calm under pressure. A crate goes missing at 6am and the booth still opens on time. The plan changes the night before and you adjust.
* Comfortable traveling about 30%, often to convention centers for several days at a time

**Nice to have**

* Construction, trades, or industrial trade show experience
* Experience routing event leads in HubSpot or Salesforce
* Experience bringing customers to the booth or onto a speaking panel
* Experience as the first or only events hire at a startup

**What we offer**

* $120K–$140K base + equity (4-year vest, 1-year cliff)
* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* 401(k) with a 100% match up to 4%
* Catered lunch in the office and $70 a month toward your commute
* A calendar and budget that are yours to shape, with results our leadership reads

**Location**

Full-time, in person at our San Francisco office (101 2nd Street), 4 days a week.  
  
**On sponsorship**

We are not able to sponsor work visas for this role at this time.

**Comp Philosophy**

Cash for stability. Bonus for performance. Equity for ownership. Your package reflects your role, your experience, and what you deliver.

Compensation Range: $120K - $140K

new_jobs.description:
**About Bobyard**
  
Construction is a multi-trillion-dollar industry that still estimates by hand. Contractors measure and count materials off drawings manually, and it caps how many jobs they can bid. Bobyard uses computer vision and NLP to automate takeoffs and estimates, so contractors bid faster and win more. We raised a $35M Series A led by 8VC, with Primary and Pear, and we're growing fast.

**About the role**
  
You'll be our first legal hire and the point person for everything legal at Bobyard. Today, legal work is spread across our leadership team and five outside law firms, and your job is to bring it into one place. You'll negotiate customer agreements, keep our contracts and terms current, and manage the firms we work with. Success is Sales never waiting on legal, and every matter having one owner and a clear next step.

**What you'll do**

* Be the single point of contact for legal requests: triage, route, and track every matter to closure
* Negotiate and redline customer agreements (MSAs, order forms, DPAs, and NDAs) within our playbook, and escalate what needs outside counsel
* Manage our outside counsel relationships, scope matters, and track legal spend
* Keep contract templates current and version-controlled as pricing and processes change
* Work with Product to keep our terms of service, privacy policy, and in-product terms accurate
* Analyze contract terms against data-privacy, security, and commercial risk, and give leadership clear recommendations
* Build the systems that make legal scale: intake, a clause playbook, and contract management

**What we're looking for**

* 0–3 years in legal operations, commercial contracts, or a transactional practice
* You've redlined or negotiated contracts yourself, not just watched
* You make a call with incomplete information, and you know when to escalate
* You can say no to a salesperson or a customer's lawyer and keep the relationship strong
* Clear, concise writing, and the follow-through to keep many matters moving at once

**Nice to have**

* Juris Doctor (JD)
* Admitted to the California bar
* SaaS agreements, DPAs, or privacy frameworks (GDPR, CCPA). CIPP/US is a plus
* Contract lifecycle management (CLM) tools
* Startup experience, or a firm serving startups

**What we offer**

* Cash for stability. Bonus for performance. Equity for ownership. Your package reflects your role, your experience, and what you deliver, and it grows as you do.
* $130,000–$155,000 base + 0.02%–0.04% equity (4-year vest, 1-year cliff)
* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* 401(k) with a 100% match up to 4%
* Catered lunch in the office and $70 a month toward your commute
* Full-time, in person at our San Francisco office (101 2nd Street), 4 days a week.

**Comp Philosophy**

Cash for stability. Bonus for performance. Equity for ownership. Your package reflects your role, your experience, and what you deliver.

Compensation Range: $130K - $155K

new_jobs.title: Enterprise Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Why Join Ivo?**
=================

Contracts are the oldest business technology in human history. They allow us to collaborate: they define what we promise each other, how we work together, and what happens when things go wrong.
  
  
Ivo builds AI products that helps companies like Meta, Uber, IBM, Intel, DoorDash, Mitsubishi Electric, and Coinbase solve their most difficult contracting problems. We think that large language models have created an opportunity to fundamentally change how businesses collaborate with each other.  
  
At Ivo you will work on challenging problems with colleagues who have high standards for each other, move fast, and care deeply about their craft.

**The Opportunity**
===================

Contracts shape how enterprises win customers, buy technology, work with partners, and manage risk. But reviewing them and finding the answers inside still takes too much expert time—slowing decisions across the business. Ivo is building AI that helps legal teams review and negotiate contracts, apply company standards, and turn agreements into actionable intelligence. Our ambition is bigger than making legal work faster: we’re building toward becoming the system of record for how enterprises work with contracts.

As Enterprise Account Manager, drive the growth of AI solutions within large enterprise clients. You’ll own renewals and expansion across major accounts, helping customers realize value and extend it across their businesses. You’ll build relationships beyond the original buyer, uncover opportunities with new teams, and grow adoption of Ivo’s expanding product portfolio—connecting each solution to a real business need. With customers like Meta, Uber, IBM and Intel, and ARR up sixfold in the last 12 months, there’s strong momentum and a playbook still to shape. You’ll help turn that opportunity into lasting, enterprise-wide partnerships.

**What You’ll Own**
-------------------

* **Take full ownership of Ivo’s largest customer relationships.** Develop and manage named accounts from prospecting to contracting across the business units. Own the commercial health, renewals, and expansion of your accounts, with the judgment and accountability to move them forward without waiting for a playbook. Build a clear view of each customer’s business, the value they’re realizing, and what stands between today’s relationship and a broader partnership. Turn that understanding into an account strategy with concrete priorities, owners, and next steps—and stay close enough to the details to make it happen.
* **Build relationships that create value across the organization.** Earn trust with day-to-day legal users, business leaders, executive sponsors, and budget owners, then extend those relationships into the teams whose work depends on contracts. Understand what each stakeholder is trying to achieve, where their priorities intersect, and where they differ. You’re not collecting contacts: you’re building a network of people who see a meaningful role for Ivo in their business and can work together to make it real.
* **Bring the right people into the conversation at the right time.** Understand how decisions actually get made: who champions change, who controls budget, who needs technical confidence, and who can block execution. Know when to deepen discovery, involve a Solutions Architect or Legal Engineer, equip a champion, or bring executives together around a strategic decision. Give every participant the context and preparation to contribute, anticipate approval requirements, and resolve dependencies before they become last-minute obstacles.
* **Be deeply analytical about where value is—and where it could be.** Partner with CSMs, who lead adoption, to connect usage patterns and customer outcomes with the account’s business priorities. Look beyond headline metrics to understand which teams are benefiting, where workflows still break down, and why promising use cases have not gained traction. Test your assumptions with customers, quantify opportunities where the evidence supports it, and distinguish genuine readiness to expand from interest that has no clear owner, budget, or business case.
* **Turn customer outcomes into a compelling case for investment.** Translate what Ivo helps customers achieve into business terms: less time spent reviewing agreements or finding answers, faster decisions, more consistent standards, and better visibility into contractual commitments and risk. Build credible business cases with clear baselines, explicit assumptions, and outcomes customers can measure. Help champions make the case internally, and lead thoughtful executive conversations about what matters, what needs to change, and why the next investment is worthwhile.
* **Help customers build toward Ivo as their system of record for contracts.** Develop a long-term vision with customers for how Ivo can become central to the way their organization works with contracts—not simply another tool used by one team. Connect that ambition to current capabilities and a practical sequence of use cases across Ivo’s expanding product portfolio. Help customers identify the stakeholders, workflow changes, and internal commitments needed to progress, so better access to contract knowledge positions their teams to move quickly and execute business decisions with confidence.
* **Run disciplined renewal and expansion cycles.** Translate account strategy into opportunities with a clear customer problem, a path to value, stakeholder alignment, and a realistic decision process. Own the commercial cycle through procurement, legal review, negotiation, and close. Surface risk early, maintain an evidence-based forecast, and build shared plans that make the next decision and its dependencies clear. Balance urgency with thoughtfulness: move quickly without skipping the work that makes a commitment durable.
* **Lead across Ivo and turn insight into action.** Bring CSMs, Solutions Architects, Product, Finance, and Legal Engine

============

Replies within 24 hours

Executive Assistant(Part-Time, Morning On Site)

**D1 Training Sandy Springs**

**Commitment:** 2 hours/day, in-person, weekday mornings — exact window set within **6:00– 10:00 AM** based on the right candidate's availability

**Pay:** $15–$20/hour, based on experience

**Reports to:** Owner, directly

The Role

I co-own D1 Training Sandy Springs and oversee it remotely. This role exists to close that gap — someone on-site each morning who keeps me organized, informed, and on top of what's actually happening at the gym, and who takes real ownership of operational and administrative work as they get familiar with how we run things.

This is a growth role, not a fixed job description. You'll start with the basics and take on more — payroll, process improvements, scheduling — as you learn our systems and earn trust.

It's a strong fit for:

A stay-at-home parent with a predictable morning window

A retired professional who wants a light, purposeful routine

A student whose morning window lands early enough (e.g., 6–8 AM) to wrap up before school starts

What You'll Actually Do

**Keep me looped in** — a quick daily rundown of what's happening at the gym and what needs my attention

**Own the operational to-do list** — track what's outstanding, follow up with the team, make sure things don't slip

**Support payroll** — start with the basics (verifying hours, prepping what I need to review), grow into more as you learn our systems

**Help manage scheduling** — staff shifts, the class calendar, or my own commitments tied to the gym, depending on where the gap is

**Keep me organized** — notes, files, tracking commitments, the general administrative backbone

**Flag process improvements** — once you know how things actually run, tell me what's inefficient or could be better

What This Isn't

Not coaching, not member-facing sales, not floor management — that stays with our GM and coaching team. This role is the organizational and administrative side working directly for me, not a second layer of gym leadership.

WhatWe're Looking For

Reliable — the same 2 hours, most mornings, is what makes this work

Comfortable with responsibility and some ambiguity — this role grows, and you'll be trusted with more as you prove you can handle it

Discreet — you'll have visibility into payroll and other sensitive information; that stays confidential

Organized, and honest when something's not getting done

No prior gym or ops experience required — we'll train you on our systems

How to Apply

Reach out to any of us:

**Chad Gazzola (Co-Owner):** 770-374-7125 or chad.gazzola@d1training.com **Jessica Kent (Co-Owner):** 770-374-6153 or jessica.kent@d1sandysprings.com **TylerAdams (General Manager):** 770-713-4301 or tyler.adams@d1sandysprings.com

**Executive Assistant – Transportation**

**What we are looking for:**

Aldridge is seeking an Executive Assistant – Transportation to join our dynamic and energetic team in Des Plaines Office - IL.

In this role, you will provide high-level strategic and administrative support to senior-level executives within our Transportation Group. The ideal candidate is a proactive, highly organized professional who can anticipate needs, manage competing priorities, exercise sound judgment, and serve as a trusted partner to executives and their teams.

**What you’ll do:**

* Provide high-level support to Transportation Group executives, ensuring seamless daily operations and alignment on key priorities.
* Independently manage complex executive calendars, proactively balancing competing priorities, meetings, and travel while navigating frequent changes.
* Coordinate extensive domestic travel arrangements, prepare detailed itineraries, and manage related logistics.
* Prepare executives for meetings by gathering agendas, background materials, presentations, reports, and other relevant information.
* Coordinate large-scale Transportation Group meetings, events, and leadership activities.
* Anticipate executive needs, identify potential issues, and proactively develop solutions.
* Track action items, commitments, and follow-ups to ensure timely completion.
* Serve as the confidential liaison and key point of contact for Transportation executives, building strong relationships with internal teams, clients, and external partners.
* Prepare correspondence, presentations, reports, and other executive communications.
* Coordinate and oversee expense reporting, data entry, and other administrative processes to ensure accuracy and timely completion.
* Exercise sound judgment in determining priorities, resolving issues, and escalating matters when appropriate.
* Adapt quickly to changing priorities and provide a high level of support in a fast-paced environment.
* Continuously look for ways to anticipate needs and improve how work gets done.
* Demonstrated commitment to our company's core values: Put People First, Foster Innovation, Be Great Partners, & Raise the Bar.
Perform other duties and assignments as required.  

**Who you are:**

* High school diploma with some business courses; an Associate's or Bachelor's degree is highly preferred.
* 5-10+ years of experience supporting senior executives in a fast-paced, high-accountability environment.
* Proven ability to independently manage complex calendars, travel, meetings, and competing priorities.
* Proficient in Google Workspace, including Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, and Slides.
* Experience with Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Visio.
* Presentation development experience is highly desirable and will be utilized regularly for executive presentations and reporting.
* Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.
* Self-motivated and proactive, with the ability to anticipate needs rather than simply respond to requests.
* Strong judgment and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and make decisions within established guidelines.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively with all levels of personnel.
* Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion.
* Ability to remain calm, flexible, and professional while managing changing priorities and time-sensitive requests.
* Ability to build trusted relationships and work collaboratively across the organization.
Willingness and ability to learn new systems, processes, and technology quickly.  

**Who we are:**

At Aldridge, we invite you to be a part of our dynamic team, where your skills are not only valued but crucial to our success. As we pursue our vision to be the First Choice for Energy and Transportation infrastructure projects, we welcome fresh perspectives and prioritize teamwork to drive our industry-leading safety, innovation, and execution.

Our culture is rooted in family-centeredness, with third-generation leadership guiding our unwavering spirit of innovation and entrepreneurship. With over 2,000 industry experts dedicated to our vision, we actively contribute to and uplift the communities impacted by our infrastructure projects and our Aldridge family.

Built on collaboration and a commitment to mental wellness, our core values create an unparalleled sense of unity and camaraderie within our organization. Through team-building events, open-door policies, and visible executive presence, we foster an environment where everyone can thrive, innovate, and make a meaningful difference. Join us in building the infrastructure that keeps the world moving and connected – become a part of the A-team to start building and strengthening your career today!

**What we offer:**

The annual base pay for this role is between $90,000.00 - 115,000.00. The actual pay is dependent upon many factors, including: location, work experience, education, training, transferable skills, business needs, and market conditions. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. The role may also be eligible for a bonus. Aldridge provides a comprehensive benefits package that includes the following:

* Health Insurance
* Dental Insurance
* Vision Insurance
* Wellness Incentive Programs
* Short and Long Term Disability
* Flexible Spending Accounts
* Life Insurance
* Legal Assistance
* Identity Protection
* Accident & Critical Illness Insurance
* Company 401(k) Matching Contributions
* Paid Time Off (PTO)
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

*This job-specific task list covers only the most important job duties. Employees assigned to this position title will also perform other occasional work assignments not mentioned above, including temporary assignments, training assignments, and other related duties. Aldridge is an EEO Employer and will recruit, hire, train, and promote people
